name: org.openrewrite.golang.AddImport
description: Add an `import` statement to a Go compilation unit. No-op if the import is already present in a compatible form.
options: [{"name":"packagePath","type":"String","displayName":"Package path","description":"The import path to add.","example":"fmt","required":true},{"name":"onlyIfReferenced","type":"Boolean","displayName":"Only if referenced","description":"When true, add the import only if some identifier in the file already references the package via type attribution.","value":false}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.ChangeMethodName
description: Rename method invocations matching a method pattern.
options: [{"name":"methodPattern","type":"String","displayName":"Method pattern","description":"A method pattern to match method invocations.","example":"fmt.Println(..)","required":true},{"name":"newMethodName","type":"String","displayName":"New method name","description":"The new name for the method.","example":"Printf","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.ChangeType
description: Change a Go type reference from one fully qualified name to another.
options: [{"name":"oldFullyQualifiedTypeName","type":"String","displayName":"Old fully qualified type name","description":"The fully qualified Go type name to replace.","example":"github.com/old/pkg.MyType","required":true},{"name":"newFullyQualifiedTypeName","type":"String","displayName":"New fully qualified type name","description":"The fully qualified Go type name to use instead.","example":"github.com/new/pkg.MyType","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.OrderImports
description: Sort `import` lines into stdlib / third-party / local groups. Within each group, entries are alphabetized; non-empty groups are separated by a blank line. Mirrors `goimports -w`. Local detection uses the sibling go.mod's module path.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.RemoveImport
description: Remove an `import` statement from a Go compilation unit. Matches by import path; any form (regular, aliased, dot, blank) is removed.
options: [{"name":"packagePath","type":"String","displayName":"Package path","description":"The import path to remove.","example":"fmt","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.RemoveUnusedImports
description: Remove imports for packages that are not referenced by any identifier in the file. Blank (`_`) imports are preserved.

name: org.openrewrite.golang.RenamePackage
description: Rename a Go package across a project — rewrites the `package` declaration in files that own the package, and rewrites import paths in every file that references it.
options: [{"name":"oldPackagePath","type":"String","displayName":"Old package path","description":"The fully qualified package path to rename.","example":"github.com/old/foo","required":true},{"name":"newPackagePath","type":"String","displayName":"New package path","description":"The fully qualified package path to use instead.","example":"github.com/new/foo","required":true}]

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AddExportedFuncComment
description: Add a stub doc comment to exported functions and methods that lack one.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AllBranchesIdentical
description: Replace an if/else chain where every branch has the same body with just the body, since the conditions have no effect on the outcome.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AllocateMapOutsideLoop
description: Hoist `make(map[...]...)` calls out of for/range loops and clear the map each iteration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AllocateOutsideLoop
description: Find `new()` calls inside for/range loops. Repeated heap allocations in loops add GC pressure; consider reusing the object.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditChannelClose
description: Find calls to the built-in `close()` function. Channels should only be closed by the sender, and double-closing causes a panic.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditContextBackground
description: Find calls to `context.Background()`. Consider using a context passed from the caller instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditExecCommand
description: Find calls to `exec.Command()`. If arguments come from user input, this is a potential command injection vulnerability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditGoroutineClosure
description: Find `go func() { ... }()` patterns. Goroutines with closures can inadvertently capture loop variables.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditHttpRedirect
description: Find calls to `http.Redirect`. Review redirect targets to ensure they are validated and status codes are appropriate.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditJsonNumber
description: Find usage of `json.Number`. json.Number should be used carefully as it can lead to unexpected behavior when converting between numeric types.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditJsonRawMessage
description: Find usage of `json.RawMessage`. RawMessage defers JSON parsing and should be reviewed to ensure deferred parsing is handled correctly.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditMultipleErrorWraps
displayName: Replace extra %w verbs with %v in fmt.Errorf
description: Replace all but the first `%w` with `%v` in `fmt.Errorf` format strings. Multiple error wrapping is invalid in Go < 1.20 and rare in later versions.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditMustFunction
description: Find calls to functions named `Must*` or `must*`, which typically panic on error.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditRecover
description: Find calls to the built-in `recover()` function, which catches panics and signals unusual control flow.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditTestFatal
description: Find `t.Fatal()` and `t.Fatalf()` calls. These abort the test immediately and panic when called from a goroutine other than the test function's goroutine.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditTestMain
description: Find `func TestMain(m *testing.M)` declarations. TestMain overrides the default test execution for the entire package.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AuditYamlUnmarshal
description: Find calls to `yaml.Unmarshal()`. YAML parsing should validate input carefully to avoid unexpected behavior from untrusted data.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidChannelLenCheck
description: Find comparisons on channel length such as `len(ch) == 0`. These are almost always racy because the length can change between the check and the next operation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidContextWithValue
description: Find calls to `context.WithValue()`. Context values are an anti-pattern for passing dependencies; prefer explicit function parameters.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidDeferInLoop
description: Wrap loop bodies containing `defer` in an immediately-invoked function literal so deferred calls run per iteration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidDotImport
description: Remove the dot alias from `import . "pkg"`, converting to a normal import.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidEmptyInterfaceParam
description: Replace `interface{}` parameter types with `any` (Go 1.18+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidFmtInLoop
description: Find `fmt.Sprintf`, `fmt.Sprint`, or `fmt.Fprintf` calls inside for/range loops. These allocate on every call; prefer direct string operations or strconv.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidFormatStringVariable
description: Find calls like `fmt.Sprintf(variable)` where the format string is not a literal. This is a potential format string vulnerability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidGlobalVariable
description: Find package-level `var` declarations. Mutable global state makes code harder to test and reason about.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidHardcodedCredentials
description: Replace hardcoded credential string literals with `os.Getenv("VAR_NAME")` calls.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidInitFunction
description: Find `func init()` declarations. Init functions make testing harder and have implicit ordering dependencies.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidLockInLoop
description: Find `Lock()` or `RLock()` calls inside for/range loops. Acquiring locks in tight loops can cause contention; consider locking once outside the loop.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidLogFatal
description: Replace `log.Fatal`, `log.Fatalf`, and `log.Fatalln` with their non-exiting equivalents (`log.Println`, `log.Printf`, `log.Println`).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidNestedGoroutine
description: Find goroutines launched inside other goroutines. Nested goroutines create hard-to-track concurrency.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidOsExit
description: Remove `os.Exit(0)` calls and flag non-zero `os.Exit(n)` which bypass deferred functions and cleanup.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidPanic
description: Find calls to the built-in `panic()` function, which crashes the program.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidReflection
description: Find `reflect.TypeOf()` and `reflect.ValueOf()` calls. Reflection is slow and should be avoided in performance-sensitive code.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidSqlStringConcat
description: Find string concatenation where the left operand contains SQL keywords. Use parameterized queries to avoid SQL injection.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidTimeSleep
description: Find calls to `time.Sleep()`. In production code, sleeping is often a code smell — consider using tickers, timers, or context-based synchronization.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.AvoidUnsafePackage
description: Find any usage of the `unsafe` package. The unsafe package bypasses Go's type safety guarantees and should be avoided unless absolutely necessary.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CheckCloseError
description: Replace bare `f.Close()` with `_ = f.Close()` to explicitly mark the discarded error.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CheckContextError
description: Find `ctx.Err()` calls. The context error should be inspected to distinguish between cancellation and deadline exceeded.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CheckTemplateExecuteError
description: Wrap bare calls to `Execute` and `ExecuteTemplate` on templates in an if-init error check so the returned error is not silently ignored.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CompileRegexOutsideLoop
description: Find `regexp.Compile()` or `regexp.MustCompile()` calls inside for/range loops. Compile the regex once outside the loop for better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.CreateChannelOutsideLoop
description: Find `make(chan ...)` calls inside for/range loops. Channel creation in loops suggests the channel should be created once before the loop.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.EnsureFileClosed
description: Find calls to `os.Open`, `os.Create`, and `os.OpenFile`. Ensure the returned file is closed to avoid resource leaks.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.EnsureSqlConnectionClosed
description: Find calls to `sql.Open`. Database connections should be managed carefully and closed when no longer needed.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.FindDeprecatedAtomicFunctions
description: Find deprecated `sync/atomic` free-function calls (e.g. `atomic.AddInt32`) that should be migrated to the type-safe atomic types introduced in Go 1.19 (e.g. `atomic.Int32`).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.FindEmptyFmtSprintf
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("")` calls with an empty format string and no args with `""`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.FindMapRangeClear
description: Replace `for k := range m { delete(m, k) }` with `clear(m)` (Go 1.21+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleCheckedError
description: Replace `if err != nil { }` with `if err != nil { return err }` so the error is propagated.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleDeferredCloseError
description: Wrap `defer x.Close()` in a closure to explicitly handle the error: `defer func() { _ = x.Close() }()`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleErrorReturn
description: Replace discarded `_` error return values with `err` to capture the error.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.HandleSwallowedError
description: Replace `if err != nil { return }` with `if err != nil { return err }` so the error is propagated.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.KeepFunctionsShort
description: Find functions with more than 20 statements. Long functions are harder to understand and maintain.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.KeepInterfacesSmall
description: Find interfaces with more than 5 methods. Large interfaces violate the Interface Segregation Principle.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.LimitFunctionParameters
description: Find functions with more than 5 parameters. Consider grouping parameters into a struct.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.LimitGoroutinesInLoop
description: Find `go` statements inside for/range loops. Unbounded goroutine creation can cause resource exhaustion; consider using a worker pool.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.LimitReturnValues
description: Find functions with more than 3 return values. Consider returning a struct instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.MergeCollapsibleIf
description: Merge nested `if` statements into a single `if` with `&&` when neither has an else clause and the outer body contains only the inner `if`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.MergeIdenticalBranches
description: Merge consecutive if/else-if branches that have identical bodies by combining their conditions with `||`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreallocateSlice
description: Find `append()` calls inside for/range loops where the slice could be preallocated.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesBufferString
description: Replace `string(buf.Bytes())` with `buf.String()` for better performance and readability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesContains
description: Replace `bytes.Index(b, sub) != -1` and similar patterns with `bytes.Contains(b, sub)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesContainsAny
description: Replace `bytes.IndexAny(b, chars) != -1` with `bytes.ContainsAny(b, chars)` and `bytes.IndexAny(b, chars) == -1` with `!bytes.ContainsAny(b, chars)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesContainsRune
description: Replace `bytes.IndexRune(b, r) != -1` with `bytes.ContainsRune(b, r)` and `bytes.IndexRune(b, r) == -1` with `!bytes.ContainsRune(b, r)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesEqual
description: Replace `bytes.Compare(a, b) == 0` with `bytes.Equal(a, b)` and `bytes.Compare(a, b) != 0` with `!bytes.Equal(a, b)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferBytesHasPrefix
description: Replace `bytes.Index(b, prefix) == 0` with `bytes.HasPrefix(b, prefix)` and `bytes.Index(b, prefix) != 0` with `!bytes.HasPrefix(b, prefix)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferCopyString
description: Replace `copy(dst, []byte(src))` with `copy(dst, src)` since copy accepts a string source.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferEmptyStringCheck
description: Replace `len(s) == 0` with `s == ""` and `len(s) != 0` with `s != ""`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorfWrapVerb
displayName: Prefer %w over %s in fmt.Errorf for error wrapping
description: Replace `%s` with `%w` in `fmt.Errorf` format strings when the corresponding argument is an error, to preserve the error chain.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsContext
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for context error comparison
description: Replace `err == context.Canceled` and `err == context.DeadlineExceeded` with `errors.Is` for correct wrapped error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsEOF
description: Replace `err == io.EOF` with `errors.Is(err, io.EOF)` and `err != io.EOF` with `!errors.Is(err, io.EOF)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsForFieldAccess
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for package-qualified sentinel comparison
description: Replace `err == sentinel` with `errors.Is(err, sentinel)` where the sentinel is a package-qualified value (e.g., `sql.ErrNoRows`). Use `errors.Is` for correct wrapped error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsForOsCheck
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for os existence checks
description: Replace deprecated `os.IsNotExist(err)` with `errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist)` and `os.IsExist(err)` with `errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsForPermission
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for os permission checks
description: Replace deprecated `os.IsPermission(err)` with `errors.Is(err, fs.ErrPermission)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferErrorsIsOverEquality
displayName: Prefer errors.Is over == for error comparison
description: Replace `err == ErrFoo` with `errors.Is(err, ErrFoo)` for correct wrapped error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferFilepathClean
description: Replace `filepath.Join(filepath.Clean(p))` with `filepath.Clean(p)` since Join with a single already-cleaned argument is redundant.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferHexEncoding
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%x", data)` with `hex.EncodeToString(data)` for clearer intent and better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoDiscard
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.Discard` with `io.Discard` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoNopCloser
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.NopCloser(r)` with `io.NopCloser(r)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoReadAll
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.ReadAll(r)` with `io.ReadAll(r)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferIoWriteString
description: Replace `fmt.Fprintf(w, "%s", s)` with `io.WriteString(w, s)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferLenCheck
description: Normalize `len(s) >= 1` to `len(s) > 0` and `len(s) < 1` to `len(s) == 0`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferMakeForEmptyMap
description: Replace empty map literal `map[K]V{}` with `make(map[K]V)` for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferMinMaxBuiltin
description: Replace `math.Min(a, b)` with `min(a, b)` and `math.Max(a, b)` with `max(a, b)` (Go 1.21+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferOsCreateTemp
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.TempFile(dir, pattern)` with `os.CreateTemp(dir, pattern)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferOsIsTimeout
displayName: Prefer errors.Is for os timeout checks
description: Replace deprecated `os.IsTimeout(err)` with `errors.Is(err, os.ErrDeadlineExceeded)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferOsMkdirTemp
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.TempDir(dir, pattern)` with `os.MkdirTemp(dir, pattern)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferOsReadDir
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.ReadDir(name)` with `os.ReadDir(name)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferOsReadFile
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.ReadFile(name)` with `os.ReadFile(name)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferOsWriteFile
description: Replace deprecated `ioutil.WriteFile(name, data, perm)` with `os.WriteFile(name, data, perm)` (Go 1.16+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferRawStringForRegex
displayName: Prefer raw string literals for regex patterns
description: Replace interpreted string literals containing backslash escapes with raw string literals in `regexp.Compile` or `regexp.MustCompile` calls.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferRegexpMustCompile
description: Collapse `x, err := regexp.Compile(p)` followed by an `if err != nil` guard into `x := regexp.MustCompile(p)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferSlicesSort
displayName: Prefer slices.Sort over sort type helpers
description: Replace deprecated `sort.Ints`, `sort.Strings`, and `sort.Float64s` with `slices.Sort` (Go 1.21+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferSortInts
description: Replace `sort.Sort(sort.IntSlice(s))` with `sort.Ints(s)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStrconvAtoi
description: Replace `strconv.ParseInt(s, 10, 0)` with `strconv.Atoi(s)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStrconvFormatBool
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%t", b)` with `strconv.FormatBool(b)` for better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStrconvItoa
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%d", n)` with `strconv.Itoa(n)` for better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStrconvQuote
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%q", s)` with `strconv.Quote(s)` for clearer intent when quoting strings.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsBuilderWriteString
description: Replace `fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%s", s)` with `b.WriteString(s)` for more efficient string building.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsContains
description: Replace `strings.Index(s, sub) != -1` and similar patterns with `strings.Contains(s, sub)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsContainsAny
description: Replace `strings.IndexAny(s, chars) != -1` with `strings.ContainsAny(s, chars)` and `strings.IndexAny(s, chars) == -1` with `!strings.ContainsAny(s, chars)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsContainsOverCount
description: Replace `strings.Count(s, sub) > 0` with `strings.Contains(s, sub)` and `strings.Count(s, sub) == 0` with `!strings.Contains(s, sub)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsContainsRune
description: Replace `strings.IndexRune(s, r) != -1` with `strings.ContainsRune(s, r)` and `strings.IndexRune(s, r) == -1` with `!strings.ContainsRune(s, r)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsEqualFold
description: Replace `strings.ToLower(s) == strings.ToLower(n)` with `strings.EqualFold(s, n)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsEqualFoldSingle
description: Replace `strings.ToLower(s) == t` and `strings.ToUpper(s) == t` with `strings.EqualFold(s, t)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsHasPrefix
description: Replace `strings.Index(s, prefix) == 0` with `strings.HasPrefix(s, prefix)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.PreferStringsNewReader
description: Replace `bytes.NewReader([]byte(s))` with `strings.NewReader(s)` to avoid an unnecessary string-to-byte-slice conversion.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.ReduceErrorCheckNesting
description: Invert `if err == nil { body }` to `if err != nil { return err }` followed by the body, reducing nesting in error-handling code.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.ReduceNestingDepth
description: Invert `if err == nil { body }` to `if err != nil { return }` followed by the body, reducing nesting by one level.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveConstantCondition
description: Remove `if true { ... }` (inline body) and `if false { ... }` (remove dead code).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveDebugPrint
description: Remove calls to `fmt.Println`, `fmt.Printf`, `fmt.Print`, `println`, and `print`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveDoubleDeref
description: Remove `*&x` where taking the address and immediately dereferencing is a no-op.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveDuplicateConditions
description: Remove else-if branches whose condition duplicates an earlier branch in the same if/else-if chain, since the later branch is dead code.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveEmptyDefault
description: Remove `default:` cases with empty bodies from switch statements.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveEmptyFunction
description: Remove free functions with empty bodies and no return type. Methods with receivers are preserved because they may implement an interface.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveEmptyGoroutine
description: Remove `go func() {}()` patterns where the goroutine body is empty.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveEmptyLoop
description: Remove `for` loops with empty bodies that spin without doing useful work.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveEmptySwitch
description: Remove `switch` statements with no case clauses. An empty switch body is dead code.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveGetterPrefix
description: Remove the "Get" prefix from method names. Go convention is that getters should not have the "Get" prefix. Callers of this method will need to be updated separately.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemovePackagePrefixFromName
description: Find exported identifiers whose name starts with the package name. Go convention discourages repeating the package name in exported identifiers.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantBreak
description: Remove trailing `break` in switch case clauses. Go switch cases do not fall through by default.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantBreakInSelect
description: Remove trailing `break` in select communication clauses. Go select cases do not fall through.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantElse
description: Remove `if ... { return } else { ... }` where the else is redundant because the if block ends with a return.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantInterfaceAssertion
displayName: Remove redundant type assertion to empty interface
description: Remove type assertions to `any` or `interface{}` which are always true and redundant.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantRangeBlank
description: Remove the blank identifier from `for i, _ := range s` loops. Use `for i := range s` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantReturn
description: Remove bare `return` at the end of functions with no return values.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantSprintf
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%s", s)` with `s` when the format string is a single %s.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveRedundantTypeConversion
description: Find type conversions like `int(x)` that may be redundant if x is already the target type. Requires type attribution for full accuracy.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveSelfAssignment
description: Remove `x = x` self-assignments which are redundant and may indicate a bug.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveSwitchTrueTag
description: Remove redundant `true` tag from `switch true { ... }` statements. Use a tagless switch instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveUnconditionalValueOverwrite
description: Remove consecutive assignments to the same collection key or index where the first value is immediately overwritten and never read.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.RemoveUnreachableCode
description: Remove statements after a `return` in the same block which are unreachable.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.ReplaceTimeSinceWithSince
description: Replace `time.Now().Sub(t)` with `time.Since(t)` for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.ReplaceTimeUntilWithUntil
description: Replace `t.Sub(time.Now())` with `time.Until(t)` for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.ResolveContextTodo
description: Replace `context.TODO()` with `context.Background()`. These are placeholders that should be replaced with a real context.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.ReuseJsonCodecInLoop
description: Find `json.Marshal()` or `json.Unmarshal()` calls inside for/range loops. Consider using a pre-allocated encoder/decoder for better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyBooleanExpression
description: Simplify boolean comparisons like `x == true` to `x` and `x == false` to `!x`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyBytesBufferRoundtrip
description: Replace `bytes.NewBuffer(b).Bytes()` with `b` since wrapping a byte slice in a buffer only to extract it is a no-op.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyBytesEqualNil
description: Replace `bytes.Equal(b, nil)` and `bytes.Equal(nil, b)` with `len(b) == 0`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyBytesSplitN
description: Replace `bytes.SplitN(b, sep, -1)` with `bytes.Split(b, sep)` since -1 means split all.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyDoubleNegation
description: Replace `!!x` with `x` to remove redundant double boolean negation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyErrorsIsNil
description: Replace redundant `errors.Is(err, nil)` with `err == nil`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyFmtSprintf
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%v", x)` with `fmt.Sprint(x)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyGoroutineClosure
description: Simplify `go func() { f() }()` to `go f()` where the closure wraps a single function call.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyIfReturnBool
description: Replace `if cond { return true }; return false` with `return cond`, and vice versa.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyNilCheckBeforeClose
description: Replace `if x != nil { x.Close() }` with `x.Close()` where the nil check is redundant.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyRedundantBytesTrimSpace
description: Replace `bytes.TrimSpace(bytes.TrimSpace(b))` with `bytes.TrimSpace(b)` since TrimSpace is idempotent.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyRedundantErrorWrap
description: Replace `fmt.Errorf("%w", err)` with `err` when wrapping adds no context.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyRedundantLenBeforeRange
displayName: Simplify redundant len check before range
description: Remove `if len(s) > 0 { for ... range s }` where the len check is redundant because range over nil/empty produces zero iterations.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyRedundantLogicalExpression
description: Simplify `x && x` to `x`, `x || x` to `x`, and similarly for `&` and `|`, where both sides of a logical or bitwise operator are identical.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyRedundantNilCheck
description: Simplify `x != nil && len(x) > 0` to `len(x) > 0` for slices and maps.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyRedundantTrimSpace
description: Replace `strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSpace(s))` with `strings.TrimSpace(s)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifySelectDefaultOnly
description: Replace `select { default: ... }` with the body statements when the select has only a default case and no communication cases.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifySingleCaseSelect
description: Replace `select` statements with a single case and no default with the channel operation directly.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifySliceRange
description: Replace `s[0:len(s)]` with `s[:]`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifySplitN
description: Replace `strings.SplitN(s, sep, -1)` with `strings.Split(s, sep)` since -1 means split all.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifySprintfChar
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%c", r)` with `string(r)` for better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifySprintfConcat
description: Replace `fmt.Sprintf("%s%s", a, b)` with `a + b` for simple string concatenation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.SimplifyTrimLeftNoop
description: Replace `strings.TrimLeft(s, "")` and `strings.TrimRight(s, "")` with `s` since trimming with an empty cutset is a no-op.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseBufferedChannel
description: Find `make(chan T)` calls without a buffer size. Unbuffered channels block until both sender and receiver are ready.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseBytesReplaceAll
description: Replace `bytes.Replace(b, old, new, -1)` with `bytes.ReplaceAll(b, old, new)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseCommaOkTypeAssertion
description: Transform bare type assertions `v := x.(T)` into `v, ok := x.(T)` with `_ = ok` to avoid panics on assertion failure.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseCryptoRand
description: Find usage of `math/rand` functions. Consider using `crypto/rand` for security-sensitive randomness.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseCtxForContextParam
description: Rename function parameters of type context.Context that are not named "ctx" to "ctx", including all usages in the function body.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseCustomHttpClient
description: Replace `http.Get`, `http.Post`, `http.Head`, and `http.PostForm` with `http.DefaultClient` equivalents to make the default client explicit.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseDescriptivePackageName
description: Find packages named util, utils, common, shared, misc, or helpers which are anti-patterns in Go.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseDescriptiveVarNames
description: Find variable declarations with single-letter names that are not conventional short names (i, j, k, n, x, y, r, w, t, s, b, v).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseDocumentedBlankImport
description: Find blank imports (`import _ "pkg"`). Blank imports are used for side effects and should be documented.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseErrPrefixForErrors
description: Find package-level error variables not following the `ErrFoo` naming convention. Go convention is to prefix sentinel errors with "Err".
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseErrorMethod
description: Replace `fmt.Sprint(err)` with `err.Error()` for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseErrorsAs
description: Replace `if myErr, ok := err.(*MyError); ok { ... }` with `var myErr *MyError; if errors.As(err, &myErr) { ... }` for correct wrapped error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseErrorsIsOverStringComparison
description: Find `err.Error() == "string"` comparisons. Comparing error messages by string is fragile; use `errors.Is` or `errors.As` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseErrorsNewForSimpleErrors
description: Replace `fmt.Errorf("static message")` with `errors.New("static message")` when there are no format verbs.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseHttpNewRequestWithContext
description: Replace deprecated `http.NewRequest(method, url, body)` with `http.NewRequestWithContext(context.TODO(), method, url, body)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseHttpServerWithTimeout
description: Replace `http.ListenAndServe(addr, handler)` with an explicit `http.Server` with read/write timeouts.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseMeaningfulReturnValues
description: Find `return nil, nil` where all returned values are nil, which may indicate a missing error or result.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseMixedCaps
description: Find exported functions using underscores instead of camelCase. Go convention is to use MixedCaps or mixedCaps.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseMixedCapsForConstants
description: Find constant or variable names using ALL_CAPS_WITH_UNDERSCORES. Go convention is to use MixedCaps, not ALL_CAPS.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseNamedConstant
description: Find numeric literals (other than 0 and 1) that should be named constants.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UsePackageLevelErrorSentinel
description: Move inline `errors.New("...")` calls to package-level sentinel variables so they can be compared with `errors.Is`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseShortReceiverName
description: Rename method receivers longer than 2 characters to the first lowercase letter of the type name.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseSkipWithReason
description: Add a placeholder reason to bare `t.Skip()` calls. Tests should document why they are skipped.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseStringsBuilderInLoop
description: Find `s += expr` inside for/range loops. Repeated string concatenation in loops is inefficient; rewrite to use strings.Builder.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseStringsReplaceAll
description: Replace `strings.Replace(s, old, new, -1)` with `strings.ReplaceAll(s, old, new)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseStructuredLogging
description: Find calls to the standard `log` package (`log.Print*`, `log.Fatal*`). Consider migrating to `log/slog` for structured logging (Go 1.21+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.UseTlsForHttp
description: Replace `http.ListenAndServe(addr, handler)` with `http.ListenAndServeTLS(addr, "cert.pem", "key.pem", handler)` to encrypt traffic in transit.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.WrapErrorBeforeReturn
description: Replace `return nil, err` with `return nil, fmt.Errorf("funcName: %%w", err)` using the enclosing function name as context.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.codequality.WrapErrorWithContext
description: Replace bare `return err` with `return fmt.Errorf("funcName: %%w", err)` using the enclosing function name as context.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.AddMissingGoModRequires
description: Add `require` directives for modules the resolved build list needs but go.mod does not declare, at their resolved versions and with the `// indirect` marker the toolchain assigned. Mirrors what `go mod tidy` adds, using the module graph resolved at parse time.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.ChangeGoVersion
description: Rewrites the `go` directive in go.mod to a new version.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.FindMissingGoModRequires
description: Find imports of third-party packages that are not covered by any `require` directive in the module's go.mod. These are the requirements `go mod tidy` would add; adding them automatically is not possible offline because it requires resolving module versions over the network.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.FindUnusedGoModRequires
description: Find direct `require` directives in go.mod that no package in the module imports. A direct requirement is only justified by a direct import, so these are candidates `go mod tidy` would remove or demote to `// indirect`. They are reported rather than removed because deciding whether a module is still needed transitively requires the module graph, which is not available offline.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.FixGoModIndirectMarkers
description: Correct the `// indirect` markers on `require` directives in go.mod: a requirement is direct when a package in the module imports it and indirect otherwise. Requirements are never removed, so the change is always build-safe; a genuinely unused requirement is marked `// indirect` rather than removed.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.FormatGoMod
description: Sort the entries of each factored `require ( … )` block in go.mod by module path, matching `go mod tidy` ordering. Versions and `// indirect` markers travel with their entry; only the ordering changes.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.GoModTidy
description: Apply `go mod tidy` behavior to go.mod: add missing requirements at their resolved versions, remove unused ones, correct the `// indirect` markers, and sort require blocks. Adding and removing require the module graph resolved at parse time, and are no-ops without it. It does not sync go.sum; the `RegenerateGoSum` recipe covers that.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.golang.migration.RemoveUnusedGoModRequires
description: Remove `require` directives whose module provides no imported package and is unreachable through the module graph from any module that does. Uses the package→module map and module graph resolved at parse time; a no-op when that resolution did not run. Modules that pin a transitive version are kept, so the removal is build-safe.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

description: Raise the `go` directive in go.mod to Go 1.21, unless it already targets 1.21 or newer.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

description: Raise the `go` directive in go.mod to Go 1.22, unless it already targets 1.22 or newer.
category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

category3Description: Recipes for improving Go code quality

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular10
description: Migrates Angular 9.x applications to Angular 10. This includes removing the deprecated `es5BrowserSupport` option from `angular.json`, renaming deprecated `validator`/`asyncValidator` to their plural forms, renaming `browserslist` to `.browserslistrc`, migrating to solution-style `tsconfig.json`, and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular11
description: Migrates Angular 10.x applications to Angular 11. This includes replacing `ViewEncapsulation.Native` with `ViewEncapsulation.ShadowDom`, removing the deprecated `extractCss` build option from `angular.json`, flagging deprecated string-based `loadChildren` and `preserveQueryParams` usage, and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular12
description: Migrates Angular 11.x applications to Angular 12. This includes adding `defaultConfiguration: "production"` to build targets in `angular.json`, replacing `node-sass` with `sass` (Dart Sass), flagging deprecated `async` test helper and View Engine APIs, and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular13
description: Migrates Angular 12.x applications to Angular 13. This includes updating `tsconfig.json` target to `es2017`, removing IE11 polyfills, removing `defaultProject` from `angular.json`, adding TestBed module teardown, simplifying `ComponentFactoryResolver` usage, and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular14
description: Migrates Angular 13.x applications to Angular 14. This includes replacing form classes with their `Untyped*` equivalents for backward compatibility with typed forms, updating deprecated `initialNavigation` router option values, removing `aotSummaries` from TestBed calls, and flagging `pathMatch` properties that may need type narrowing.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular15
description: Migrates Angular 14.x applications to Angular 15. This includes removing the `relativeLinkResolution` option from `RouterModule.forRoot()`, removing the `enableIvy` compiler option from `tsconfig.json`, flagging the deprecated `DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE` token and `providedIn: NgModule`/`'any'` usage, and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular16
description: Migrates Angular 15.x applications to Angular 16. This includes removing `entryComponents` and `moduleId` from decorators, replacing `RouterLinkWithHref` with `RouterLink`, moving the `XhrFactory` import to `@angular/common`, and flagging removed APIs like `ReflectiveInjector`, `renderModuleFactory`, and `BrowserTransferStateModule`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular17
description: Migrates Angular 16.x applications to Angular 17. This includes updating Angular package versions, replacing legacy deep `zone.js` imports, flagging the removed `withNoDomReuse` and `setupTestingRouter` APIs, and upgrading TypeScript and `zone.js` dependencies.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular18
description: Migrates Angular 17.x applications to Angular 18. This includes replacing the deprecated `async` test helper with `waitForAsync`, migrating `HttpClientModule` to `provideHttpClient()`, moving Transfer State APIs to `@angular/core`, and flagging removed platform APIs.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular19
description: Migrates Angular 18.x applications to Angular 19. This includes updating Angular package versions, adjusting the standalone default, renaming `ExperimentalPendingTasks` to `PendingTasks`, moving the `ApplicationConfig` import to `@angular/core`, and updating `zone.js`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular20
description: Migrates Angular 19.x applications to Angular 20. This includes running the Angular 19 migration first, then updating Angular package versions, renaming experimental APIs promoted to stable, and upgrading TypeScript to 5.8.x.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular21
description: Migrates Angular 20.x applications to Angular 21. This includes running the Angular 20 migration first, flagging Karma test runner usage for Vitest migration, deprecated NgClass, zone.js-dependent test helpers, and upgrading TypeScript to 5.9.x.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular8
description: Migrates Angular 7.x applications to Angular 8. This includes adding the now-required `static: false` to `@ViewChild` and `@ContentChild` decorators, moving the `DOCUMENT` import from `@angular/platform-browser` to `@angular/common`, removing `rxjs-compat` and flagging any remaining RxJS 5-style imports, flagging removed `@angular/http` imports, converting deprecated string-based `loadChildren` to dynamic imports, and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.UpgradeToAngular9
description: Migrates Angular 8.x applications to Angular 9. This includes removing the now-default `static: false` from view query decorators, replacing `TestBed.get()` with `TestBed.inject()`, adding generic type parameters to `ModuleWithProviders`, enabling AOT compilation in `angular.json`, updating `tsconfig.json` module settings for Ivy, flagging removed View Engine APIs (`Renderer`, `RenderComponentType`, `RootRenderer`), and upgrading Angular, TypeScript, and related dependency versions.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.add-default-configuration
description: Adds `"defaultConfiguration": "production"` to build architect targets in `angular.json`. Angular 12 changed `ng build` to produce production bundles by default.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.add-localize-polyfill
description: Adds `import '@angular/localize/init'` to `polyfills.ts`. Angular 9 introduced the `$localize` runtime API for i18n. Projects using internationalization must import this polyfill or the application will fail at runtime with `$localize is not defined`. The `@angular/localize` package must also be added as a dependency.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.add-module-with-providers-generic
description: Adds the required generic type parameter to bare `ModuleWithProviders` return types. Angular 10 requires `ModuleWithProviders<T>` where `T` is the NgModule type. The module type is inferred from the `ngModule` property in the return statement.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.add-static-false-to-view-queries
description: Adds `static: false` to `@ViewChild` and `@ContentChild` decorators that don't have the `static` property. Angular 8 requires an explicit `static` flag for view query decorators. Using `static: false` preserves the Angular 7 default behavior (queries resolved after change detection).

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.add-testbed-teardown
description: Adds `{ teardown: { destroyAfterEach: true } }` as the third argument to `TestBed.initTestEnvironment()` calls. Angular 13 changed the default teardown behavior, and this ensures explicit opt-in for module teardown after each test.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.enable-aot-build
description: Adds `"aot": true` to build options in `angular.json`. Angular 9 made AOT compilation the default, and projects upgrading from Angular 8 should enable it explicitly.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.explicit-standalone-flag
description: Adds `standalone: false` to non-standalone Angular components, directives, and pipes, and removes redundant `standalone: true` since it became the default in Angular 19.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.migrate-constructor-to-inject
description: Converts constructor parameter properties in Angular classes to field declarations using the `inject()` function. For example, `constructor(private svc: MyService) {}` becomes `private svc = inject(MyService);`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.migrate-input-to-signal
description: Converts `@Input()` decorated properties in Angular classes to signal-based `input()` declarations. For example, `@Input() name: string` becomes `name = input<string>()`, and `@Input({ required: true }) name!: string` becomes `name = input.required<string>()`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.migrate-output-to-signal
description: Converts `@Output()` decorated properties using `EventEmitter` in Angular classes to signal-based `output()` declarations. For example, `@Output() clicked = new EventEmitter<void>()` becomes `clicked = output<void>()`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.migrate-query-to-signal
displayName: Migrate query decorators to signal-based functions
description: Converts `@ViewChild()`, `@ViewChildren()`, `@ContentChild()`, and `@ContentChildren()` decorated properties to signal-based query functions. For example, `@ViewChild('ref') el: ElementRef` becomes `el = viewChild<ElementRef>('ref')`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.migrate-to-solution-style-tsconfig
description: Migrates a project to use a solution-style `tsconfig.json`. The original `tsconfig.json` content is moved to `tsconfig.base.json` (with project-specific fields removed), and `tsconfig.json` is replaced with a solution-style config that references the project's TypeScript configurations. Other tsconfig files that extend `./tsconfig.json` are updated to extend `./tsconfig.base.json`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.move-document-import
description: Moves the `DOCUMENT` import from older Angular modules to `@angular/core`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-aot-summaries
description: Removes the `aotSummaries` property from `TestBed.configureTestingModule()` and `TestBed.initTestEnvironment()` calls. The `aotSummaries` parameter was removed in Angular 14 as it was only needed for the View Engine compiler.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-browser-module-with-server-transition
description: Replaces `BrowserModule.withServerTransition({ appId: '...' })` with `BrowserModule` and adds `{ provide: APP_ID, useValue: '...' }` to the NgModule providers. The `withServerTransition` method was removed in Angular 19.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-component-factory-resolver
description: Replaces `resolver.resolveComponentFactory(Component)` with just `Component` and removes the `ComponentFactoryResolver` import. Since Ivy, `ViewContainerRef.createComponent` accepts the component class directly. `ComponentFactoryResolver` was deprecated in Angular 13 and removed in Angular 16.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-default-project
description: Removes the deprecated `defaultProject` property from `angular.json`. The `defaultProject` option was deprecated in Angular 13 and the CLI infers the default project from the workspace.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-empty-ng-on-init
description: Removes empty `ngOnInit` lifecycle hook methods and OnInit interface from Angular components.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-enable-ivy
description: Removes the `enableIvy` option from `angularCompilerOptions` in `tsconfig.json`. Ivy is the only rendering engine since Angular 12, and the option was removed in Angular 15.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-entry-components
description: Removes the `entryComponents` property from `@NgModule` and `@Component` decorators, and removes the `ANALYZE_FOR_ENTRY_COMPONENTS` import. These were removed in Angular 16 as they served no purpose since Ivy.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-es5-browser-support
description: Removes the deprecated `es5BrowserSupport` option from `angular.json`. `es5BrowserSupport` was deprecated in Angular 7.3 and removed in Angular 10. Differential loading is now handled automatically by the Angular CLI based on the project's browserslist configuration.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-extract-css
description: Removes the deprecated `extractCss` build option from `angular.json`. In Angular 11, CSS extraction became the default behavior for production builds and the option was deprecated.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-ie-polyfills
description: Removes IE11-specific polyfill imports (`core-js`, `classlist.js`, `web-animations-js`) from `polyfills.ts` and `angular.json`. Angular 13 dropped IE11 support, making these polyfills unnecessary.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-module-id
description: Removes the `moduleId` property from `@Component` and `@Directive` decorators. `moduleId` was deprecated in Angular 16 and removed in Angular 17 as it served no purpose since Ivy.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-relative-link-resolution
description: Removes the `relativeLinkResolution` option from `RouterModule.forRoot()` calls. This option was deprecated in Angular 14 and removed in Angular 15.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-standalone-true
description: Removes the `standalone: true` property from Angular component, directive, and pipe decorators since standalone is the default in Angular 19+.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-static-false
description: Removes `static: false` from `@ViewChild`, `@ContentChild`, `@ViewChildren`, and `@ContentChildren` decorators. In Angular 9 with Ivy, `static: false` became the default behavior, making the explicit option unnecessary.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.remove-zone-js-polyfill
description: Removes zone.js entries from the `polyfills` array in `angular.json`. Angular 20 supports zoneless change detection via `provideZonelessChangeDetection()`, making the zone.js polyfill unnecessary.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.rename-after-render
description: Renames `afterRender` to `afterEveryRender` in imports and usages. The `afterRender` function was renamed to `afterEveryRender` in Angular 20, and Angular provides no migration schematic for this change.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.rename-check-no-changes
description: Renames `provideExperimentalCheckNoChangesForDebug` to `provideCheckNoChangesForDebug` in imports and usages. The experimental API was promoted to developer preview in Angular 20.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.rename-file
description: Renames files matching a glob pattern to a new file name, preserving the directory.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.rename-pending-tasks
description: Renames `ExperimentalPendingTasks` to `PendingTasks` in imports and usages. `ExperimentalPendingTasks` was renamed in Angular 19.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.rename-zoneless-provider
description: Renames `provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection` to `provideZonelessChangeDetection` in imports and usages. The experimental API was promoted to developer preview in Angular 20.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-async-with-wait-for-async
description: Replaces the removed `async` test helper from `@angular/core/testing` with `waitForAsync`. The `async` function was deprecated in Angular 11 and removed in Angular 18.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-deep-zone-js-imports
description: Replaces legacy deep imports from `zone.js` such as `zone.js/dist/zone` or `zone.js/bundles/zone-testing.js` with the standard `zone.js` or `zone.js/testing` imports, in both TypeScript files and `angular.json` polyfills. Deep imports are no longer allowed in Angular 17.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-http-client-module
description: Replaces deprecated `HttpClientModule`, `HttpClientJsonpModule`, `HttpClientXsrfModule`, and `HttpClientTestingModule` with their functional equivalents: `provideHttpClient()` with feature functions and `provideHttpClientTesting()`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-initial-navigation
description: Replaces deprecated `initialNavigation` router option values: `'legacy_enabled'` and `true` become `'enabledBlocking'`, `'legacy_disabled'` and `false` become `'disabled'`, and `'enabled'` becomes `'enabledNonBlocking'`. The legacy values were removed in Angular 11; `'enabled'` was renamed in Angular 14.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-inject-flags
description: Replaces deprecated `InjectFlags` enum usage in `inject()` calls with the corresponding options object. For example, `inject(MyService, InjectFlags.Optional)` becomes `inject(MyService, { optional: true })`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-load-children-string
description: Converts the deprecated string-based `loadChildren: 'path#Module'` syntax to dynamic imports: `loadChildren: () => import('path').then(m => m.Module)`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-node-sass-with-sass
description: Replaces the deprecated `node-sass` package with `sass` (Dart Sass). Angular 12 requires Dart Sass; `node-sass` is no longer supported.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-router-link-with-href
description: Replaces `RouterLinkWithHref` with `RouterLink` in imports and usages. `RouterLinkWithHref` was merged into `RouterLink` in Angular 16.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-testbed-get-with-inject
description: Replaces deprecated `TestBed.get()` calls with `TestBed.inject()`. `TestBed.get()` was deprecated in Angular 9 and removed in Angular 13.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-untyped-forms
displayName: Replace form classes with untyped variants
description: Renames `FormControl`, `FormGroup`, `FormArray`, and `FormBuilder` to their `Untyped*` equivalents in imports and usages. Angular 14 introduced strictly typed forms, requiring existing untyped usages to migrate to the `Untyped*` aliases. Classes used in parameterized type positions (e.g. `FormGroup<T>`) are left unchanged because the user already opted into typed forms.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-validator-with-validators
description: Renames the deprecated singular `validator` and `asyncValidator` property names to `validators` and `asyncValidators` (plural). Angular 10 deprecated the singular forms in favor of `AbstractControlOptions`.

name: org.openrewrite.angular.migration.replace-view-encapsulation-native
description: Replaces `ViewEncapsulation.Native` with `ViewEncapsulation.ShadowDom`. `ViewEncapsulation.Native` was deprecated in Angular 6 and removed in Angular 11.

description: Updates the `templateUrl` property value in Angular `@Component` decorators. Useful for refactoring template file paths or standardizing path conventions.
