category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantDisposeOrClose
description: Remove Dispose/Close calls on objects already in a using block.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantOverridingMember
description: Remove overriding member that only calls the base implementation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantParentheses
description: Remove unnecessary parentheses around expressions in return statements and assignments.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantRegion
description: Remove #region/#endregion directives.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantSealedModifier
description: Remove `sealed` modifier on members of sealed classes, since it's redundant.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantSealedModifierFromOverride
description: Remove redundant 'sealed' modifier from an overriding member in a sealed class.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantStatement
description: Remove redundant `return;` at end of void method or `continue;` at end of loop body.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantStringToCharArrayCall
description: Remove `ToCharArray()` calls in foreach loops where iterating over the string directly produces the same result.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveRedundantToStringCall
description: Remove `ToString()` calls on expressions that are already strings.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveSelfAssignment
description: Remove assignment statements where the variable is assigned to itself, such as `x = x`. These have no effect and are likely copy-paste errors.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnconditionalValueOverwrite
description: Remove consecutive assignments to the same collection key or index where the first value is immediately overwritten and never read.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnnecessaryCaseLabel
description: Remove case labels from switch section that has default label.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnnecessaryElse
description: Remove `else` clause when the `if` body always terminates with `return`, `throw`, `break`, `continue`, or `goto`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnnecessarySemicolon
displayName: Remove unnecessary semicolon at end of declaration
description: Remove unnecessary semicolon at the end of a declaration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnusedDocCommentElement
description: Remove unused param/typeparam elements from XML documentation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnusedMemberDeclaration
description: Remove member declarations that are never referenced.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.RemoveUnusedThisParameter
description: Remove unused 'this' parameter from extension methods.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.ResourceCanBeDisposedAsynchronously
description: Use `await using` instead of `using` when the resource implements IAsyncDisposable.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryEnumFlag
description: Remove unnecessary enum flag value that is a combination of other flags.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryInterpolatedString
description: Replace interpolated strings with no interpolations with regular strings.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryInterpolation
description: Remove unnecessary string interpolation, for example simplifying `$"{x}"` to `x.ToString()`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryNullCheck
description: Remove null check that is unnecessary because the value is known to be non-null.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryNullForgivingOperator
description: Remove ! operator where expression is already non-nullable.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryRawStringLiteral
description: Convert raw string literal to regular string when not needed.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryUnsafeContext
description: Remove unsafe blocks that do not contain unsafe code.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UnnecessaryVerbatimStringLiteral
description: Remove @ prefix from string literals that do not contain escape sequences.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Redundancy.UseRethrow
displayName: Use rethrow instead of throw ex
description: Replace `throw ex;` with `throw;` inside catch clauses when `ex` is the caught exception variable. A bare `throw` preserves the original stack trace.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.CombineWhereMethodChain
description: Combine consecutive Enumerable.Where method calls into a single call with a combined predicate.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.ConvertAnonymousMethodToLambda
description: Convert anonymous method delegate syntax to lambda expression.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.ConvertIfToAssignment
description: Convert 'if' statement that assigns boolean literals to a simple assignment with the condition expression.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.ConvertInterpolatedStringToConcatenation
description: Detect string interpolations that could be simplified to concatenation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.ExpressionAlwaysTrueOrFalse
displayName: Expression is always true or false
description: Simplify `x == x` to `true` and `x != x` to `false`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.InlineLazyInitialization
description: Use null-coalescing assignment (??=) for lazy initialization.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.InlineLocalVariable
description: Inline local variable that is assigned once and used once immediately.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.JoinStringExpressions
description: Join consecutive string literal concatenations into a single literal.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.MergeElseWithNestedIf
description: Merge `else { if (...) { } }` into `else if (...) { }` when the else block contains only a single if statement.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.MergeIdenticalBranches
description: Merge consecutive if/else-if branches that have identical bodies by combining their conditions with `||`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.MergeIfWithParentIf
description: Merge `if (a) { if (b) { ... } }` into `if (a && b) { ... }` when the outer if body contains only a single nested if without else.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.MergeSwitchSections
displayName: Merge switch sections with equivalent content
description: Merge switch case labels that have identical bodies.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.RemoveRedundantBooleanLiteral
description: Remove redundant `== true` comparison from boolean expressions.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.RemoveUnnecessaryBraces
description: Remove braces from single-statement blocks where they are optional.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplificationCodeQuality
description: Simplify expressions and patterns in C# code.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyArgumentNullCheck
description: Use ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(arg) instead of manual null check.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyBooleanComparison
description: Simplify `true == x` to `x`, `false == x` to `!x`, `true != x` to `!x`, and `false != x` to `x`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyCoalesceExpression
description: Simplify x ?? x to x.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyCodeBranching
description: Simplify code branching patterns such as empty if-else, while(true) with break, and trailing return/continue in if-else.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyConditionalExpression
description: Simplify `cond ? true : false` to `cond` and `cond ? false : true` to `!cond`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyDoWhileToWhile
description: Convert `do { ... } while (true)` to `while (true) { ... }`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyLazyInitialization
description: Simplify lazy initialization using ??= operator.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyLogicalNegation
description: Simplify negated comparison expressions. For example, `!(x == y)` becomes `x != y`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyNegatedIsNull
description: Simplify `!(x is null)` to `x is not null` and `!(x is not null)` to `x is null`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyNestedUsingStatement
description: Merge nested `using` statements into a single `using` declaration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyNullableHasValue
description: Replace `x.HasValue` with `x != null` and `!x.HasValue` with `x == null`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyNullableToShorthand
description: Use T? shorthand instead of Nullable<T>.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyNumericComparison
description: Simplify `x - y > 0` to `x > y`, `x - y < 0` to `x < y`, `x - y >= 0` to `x >= y`, and `x - y <= 0` to `x <= y`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyRedundantLogicalExpression
description: Simplify `x && x` to `x`, `x || x` to `x`, and similarly for `&` and `|`, where both sides of a logical or bitwise operator are identical.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.SimplifyRedundantWhereWhere
description: Detect consecutive `.Where(p).Where(q)` calls that could be merged.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UnconstrainedTypeParamNullCheck
displayName: Unconstrained type parameter checked for null
description: Find null checks on unconstrained type parameters, which may not be reference types.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UnnecessaryOperator
description: Remove unnecessary operators such as unary plus.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseAnonymousFunctionOrMethodGroup
displayName: Use anonymous function or method group
description: Convert a lambda expression to a method group where appropriate.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseCoalesceExpression
description: Replace `x != null ? x : y` and `x == null ? y : x` with `x ?? y`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseCoalesceExpressionInsteadOfIf
description: Replace `if (x == null) x = y;` with `x ??= y`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseCompoundAssignment
description: Replace `x = x op y` with `x op= y` for arithmetic, bitwise, shift, and null-coalescing operators.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseConditionalAccess
description: Transform null-check patterns to use conditional access (?.).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseConditionalAccessInsteadOfIf
displayName: Use conditional access instead of conditional expression
description: Transform ternary null-check expressions to use conditional access (?.) with null-coalescing (??) where needed.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseConditionalExpressionForDeclaration
description: Convert `int x; if (cond) x = a; else x = b;` to `int x = cond ? a : b;`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseConditionalExpressionForReturn
description: Convert `if (c) return a; return b;` to `return c ? a : b;`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseConditionalExpressionForThrow
description: Detect `if (x == null) throw ...` patterns that could use `x ?? throw ...`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseDateTimeOffsetUnixEpoch
description: Replace `new DateTimeOffset(1970, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, TimeSpan.Zero)` with `DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch`. Available since .NET 8, `DateTimeOffset.UnixEpoch` is more readable.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseDateTimeUnixEpoch
description: Replace `new DateTime(1970, 1, 1)` with `DateTime.UnixEpoch`. Available since .NET 8, `DateTime.UnixEpoch` is more readable and avoids magic numbers.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseDefaultLiteral
description: Simplify default(T) expressions to default. Note: in rare cases where the type cannot be inferred (e.g., overload resolution), manual review may be needed.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseExceptionFilter
description: Detect catch blocks with if/throw pattern that could use a when clause.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseExpressionBodiedLambda
description: Convert block-body lambdas with a single statement to expression-body lambdas.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseForInsteadOfWhile
displayName: Use for statement instead of while
description: Convert while loops with counter to for loops.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseGuidEmpty
description: Replace `new Guid()` with `Guid.Empty`. The static `Guid.Empty` field avoids unnecessary allocations and clearly expresses intent.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseIsOperatorInsteadOfAs
description: Replace 'as' operator followed by null check with 'is' operator.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseIsPatternInsteadOfSequenceEqual
description: Replace `span.SequenceEqual("str")` with `span is "str"`. Pattern matching with string constants is more concise for span comparisons.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseNotPattern
description: Detect `!(x is Type)` patterns that can use `x is not Type`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePatternMatchingForEquality
displayName: Use pattern matching for equality comparison
description: Replace `x == constant` with `x is constant` for improved readability using C# pattern matching.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePatternMatchingForInequality
displayName: Use pattern matching for inequality comparison
description: Replace `x != constant` with `x is not constant` for improved readability using C# pattern matching.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePatternMatchingInsteadOfAs
displayName: Use pattern matching instead of as
description: Use pattern matching instead of as. Note: Needs type resolution.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePatternMatchingInsteadOfHasValue
displayName: Use pattern matching instead of HasValue
description: Replace `nullable.HasValue` with `nullable is not null`. Pattern matching is more idiomatic in modern C#. Note: this recipe uses name-based matching and may match non-Nullable types with a `HasValue` property.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePatternMatchingInsteadOfIs
displayName: Use pattern matching instead of is
description: Use pattern matching instead of is. Note: Needs type resolution.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePatternMatchingNullCheck
displayName: Use pattern matching for null check
description: Replace `x == null` with `x is null` and `x != null` with `x is not null`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UsePostfixIncrement
description: Replace `x = x + 1` with `x++` and `x = x - 1` with `x--`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseRangeOperator
description: Detect Substring calls that could use C# 8 range syntax.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseShortCircuitOperator
description: Replace bitwise `&` with `&&` and `|` with `||` in boolean contexts.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseStringEndsWith
description: Detect substring comparison patterns that could use EndsWith.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseStringEquals
displayName: Use string.Equals instead of == for string comparison
description: Replace `==` string comparisons with `string.Equals(a, b, StringComparison.Ordinal)` for explicit comparison semantics.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseStringInterpolation
displayName: Use string interpolation instead of string.Format
description: Replace simple `string.Format("{0}", x)` calls with `$"{x}"`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseStringInterpolationInsteadOfConcat
displayName: Use string interpolation instead of concatenation
description: Replace string.Concat with string interpolation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseStringStartsWith
displayName: Use string.StartsWith instead of IndexOf comparison
description: Replace `s.IndexOf(x) == 0` with `s.StartsWith(x)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseSwitchExpression
description: Convert simple switch statements to switch expressions (C# 8+).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseThrowExpression
description: Convert null-check-then-throw patterns to throw expressions.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseTimeSpanZero
description: Replace `new TimeSpan(0)` and `TimeSpan.FromX(0)` with `TimeSpan.Zero`. The static `TimeSpan.Zero` field is more readable and avoids unnecessary object creation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Simplification.UseXorForBooleanInequality
description: Replace a != b with a ^ b when both operands are boolean.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AbstractTypeShouldNotHavePublicConstructors
displayName: Abstract type should not have public constructors
description: Change public constructors of abstract types to protected.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AddParenthesesForClarity
description: Add parentheses to expressions where operator precedence might be unclear to improve readability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AddParenthesesToConditionalExpression
displayName: Add parentheses to conditional expression condition
description: Add or remove parentheses from the condition in a conditional operator.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AddRemoveTrailingComma
displayName: Add trailing comma to last enum member
description: Add trailing comma to the last member of enum declarations for cleaner diffs when adding new members.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AddStaticToMembersOfStaticClass
displayName: Add static modifier to all members of static class
description: Ensure all members of a static class are also declared static.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AddTrailingComma
description: Add trailing commas to multi-line initializers and enum declarations for cleaner diffs.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AvoidChainOfAssignments
description: Flag chained assignment expressions like a = b = c = value.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.AvoidNestingTernary
description: Replace nested ternary expressions with if/else chains for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.CallExtensionMethodAsInstance
displayName: Call extension method as instance method
description: Use instance method syntax instead of static extension method call.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.CompositeEnumContainsUndefinedFlag
displayName: Composite enum value contains undefined flag
description: Find composite enum values that contain a flag which is not defined in the enum type.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ConstantValuesOnRightSide
displayName: Place constant values on right side of comparisons
description: Move constant values (literals, null) from the left side of comparisons to the right side for consistency and readability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ConvertCommentToDocComment
description: Convert single-line or multi-line comments above declarations to XML documentation comments.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DeclareEachAttributeSeparately
description: Declare each attribute in a separate attribute list.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DeclareEachTypeInSeparateFile
displayName: Declare each type in separate file
description: Declare each type in a separate file.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DeclareEachTypeSeparately
displayName: Declare each type in separate file
description: Flag files containing multiple top-level type declarations.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DeclareEnumMemberWithZeroValue
displayName: Declare enum member with zero value
description: Ensure [Flags] enums have a member explicitly assigned the value 0.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DeclareEnumValueAsCombination
displayName: Declare enum value as combination of names
description: Declare Flags enum values as combinations of named values.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DeclareUsingDirectiveOnTopLevel
displayName: Declare using directive on top level
description: Move using directives outside of namespace declarations to the top level of the file.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DefaultLabelShouldBeLast
description: Move default label to the last position in switch statement.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DuplicateEnumValue
description: Flag enum members that have the same underlying value.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.DuplicateWordInComment
description: Find and fix duplicate consecutive words in comments.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.EnumShouldDeclareExplicitValues
description: Add explicit values to enum members that do not have them.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindArgumentExceptionParameterName
description: When throwing `ArgumentException` or derived types, specify the parameter name using `nameof()`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindAsyncMethodReturnsNull
description: Detect `async void` methods. Use `async Task` instead so callers can await and exceptions propagate correctly.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindAsyncVoidDelegate
description: Detect async lambdas used as delegates where the return type is void. Use `Func<Task>` instead of `Action` for async delegates.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindAvoidAnonymousDelegateForUnsubscribe
displayName: Do not use anonymous delegates to unsubscribe from events
description: Unsubscribing from events using anonymous delegates or lambdas has no effect because each lambda creates a new delegate instance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindAwaitTaskBeforeDisposing
displayName: Find unawaited task return in using block
description: Detect `return` of a Task inside a `using` block without `await`. The resource may be disposed before the task completes.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindBothConditionSidesIdentical
displayName: Find binary expression with identical sides
description: Detect binary expressions where both sides are identical, e.g. `x == x` or `a && a`. This is likely a copy-paste bug.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindClassWithEqualsButNoIEquatable
displayName: Find class with Equals(T) but no IEquatable<T>
description: Detect classes that define `Equals(T)` but do not implement `IEquatable<T>`. Implementing the interface ensures consistency and enables value-based equality.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindCompareToWithoutIComparable
description: Detect classes that provide a `CompareTo` method but do not implement `IComparable<T>`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDangerousThreadingMethods
displayName: Do not use dangerous threading methods
description: Avoid `Thread.Abort()`, `Thread.Suspend()`, and `Thread.Resume()`. These methods are unreliable and can corrupt state.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDefaultParameterValueNeedsOptional
description: Detect parameters with `[DefaultParameterValue]` that are missing `[Optional]`. Both attributes are needed for COM interop default parameter behavior.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotCallVirtualMethodInConstructor
displayName: Find virtual method call in constructor
description: Detect calls to virtual or abstract methods within constructors. Derived classes may not be fully initialized when these methods execute.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotCompareWithNaN
description: Detect comparisons with `NaN` using `==` or `!=`. Use `double.IsNaN()` or `float.IsNaN()` instead, as `x == NaN` is always false.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotCreateTypeWithBCLName
description: Detect class declarations that use names from well-known BCL types like `Task`, `Action`, `String`, which can cause confusion.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotDeclareStaticMembersOnGenericTypes
displayName: Find static members on generic types
description: Detect static members declared on generic types. Static members on generic types require specifying type arguments at the call site, reducing discoverability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotOverwriteParameterValue
description: Detect assignments to method parameters, which can mask the original argument and lead to confusion.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotPassNullForCancellationToken
description: Detect `null` or `default` passed for `CancellationToken` parameters. Use `CancellationToken.None` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotRaiseApplicationException
description: Avoid throwing `ApplicationException`. Use a more specific exception type.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotRaiseNotImplementedException
description: Throwing `NotImplementedException` indicates incomplete implementation. Implement the functionality or throw a more specific exception.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotRaiseReservedExceptionType
displayName: Do not raise reserved exception types
description: Avoid throwing `Exception`, `SystemException`, or `ApplicationException`. Use more specific exception types.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotThrowFromFinalizer
description: Detect `throw` statements inside finalizer/destructor methods. Throwing from a finalizer can terminate the process.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotThrowFromFinallyBlock
displayName: Do not throw from finally block
description: Throwing from a `finally` block can mask the original exception and make debugging difficult.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotUseCertificateValidationCallback
displayName: Do not write custom certificate validation
description: Custom certificate validation callbacks can introduce security vulnerabilities by accidentally accepting invalid certificates.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotUseEqualityComparerDefaultOfString
description: Detect `EqualityComparer<string>.Default` which may use different comparison semantics across platforms. Use an explicit `StringComparer`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotUseGetHashCodeForString
description: Detect `.GetType()` called on an object that is already a `System.Type`. Use `typeof()` directly.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotUseObjectToString
description: Detect `.ToString()` calls on `object`-typed parameters. The default `object.ToString()` returns the type name, which is rarely the intended behavior.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotUseSleep
description: Detect `Thread.Sleep()` which blocks the thread. Use `await Task.Delay()` in async contexts instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindDoNotUseStringGetHashCode
description: Detect `string.GetHashCode()` which is not stable across runs. Use `StringComparer.GetHashCode()` or `string.GetHashCode(StringComparison)` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindEmbedCaughtExceptionAsInner
displayName: Embed caught exception as inner exception
description: When rethrowing a different exception in a catch block, pass the original exception as the inner exception to preserve the stack trace.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindEnumDefaultValueZero
displayName: Find explicit zero initialization in enum
description: Detect enum members explicitly initialized to `0`. The default value of an enum is already `0`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindEqualsWithoutNotNullWhen
description: Detect `Equals(object?)` overrides that are missing `[NotNullWhen(true)]` on the parameter, which helps nullable analysis.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindEventArgsSenderNotNull
displayName: Find event raised with null EventArgs
description: Detect event invocations that pass `null` for EventArgs. Use `EventArgs.Empty` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindFlowCancellationTokenInAwaitForEach
description: Detect `await foreach` loops that don't pass a `CancellationToken` via `WithCancellation()` when one is available in the enclosing method.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindIComparableWithoutComparisonOperators
description: Detect classes that implement `IComparable<T>` but do not override comparison operators (`<`, `>`, `<=`, `>=`).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindIComparableWithoutIEquatable
description: Detect classes that implement `IComparable<T>` but not `IEquatable<T>`. Both interfaces should be implemented together for consistent comparison semantics.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindIEquatableWithoutEquals
description: Detect classes that implement `IEquatable<T>` but do not override `Equals(object)`, which can lead to inconsistent equality behavior.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindILoggerTypeMismatch
description: Detect `ILogger<T>` fields or parameters where `T` doesn't match the containing type name.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindIfElseBranchesIdentical
description: Detect `if/else` statements where both branches contain identical code. This is likely a copy-paste bug.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindImplementNonGenericInterface
description: Detect types implementing `IComparable<T>` without `IComparable`, or `IEquatable<T>` without proper Equals override.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindImplicitCultureSensitiveToStringDirect
displayName: Find implicit culture-sensitive ToString in concatenation
description: Detect string concatenation with numeric types that implicitly call culture-sensitive `ToString()`. Use an explicit format or `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindImplicitDateTimeOffsetConversion
displayName: Find implicit DateTime to DateTimeOffset conversion
description: Detect implicit conversion from `DateTime` to `DateTimeOffset` which uses the local time zone and can produce unexpected results.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindInterpolatedStringWithoutParameters
description: Detect interpolated strings (`$"..."`) that contain no interpolation expressions. Use a regular string literal instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindInvalidAttributeArgumentType
displayName: Find potentially invalid attribute argument type
description: Detect attribute arguments that use types not valid in attribute constructors (only primitives, string, Type, enums, and arrays of these are allowed).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMethodReturningIAsyncEnumerable
displayName: Find IAsyncEnumerable method without Async suffix
description: Detect methods returning `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` that don't end with `Async`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMethodTooLong
displayName: Find method that is too long
description: Detect methods with more than 60 statements. Long methods are harder to understand and maintain.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMissingCancellationTokenOverload
description: Detect async method calls that don't pass a `CancellationToken` when the enclosing method has one available as a parameter.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMissingNamedParameter
displayName: Find boolean literal arguments without parameter name
description: Detect method calls passing `true` or `false` literals as arguments. Using named parameters improves readability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMissingParamsInOverride
displayName: Find override method missing params keyword
description: Detect override methods that may be missing the `params` keyword on array parameters that the base method declares as `params`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMissingStringComparison
description: Detect string methods like `Equals`, `Contains`, `StartsWith`, `EndsWith` called without an explicit `StringComparison` parameter.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMissingStringEqualityComparer
description: Detect `Dictionary<string, T>` and `HashSet<string>` created without an explicit `StringComparer`. Without a comparer, the default ordinal comparison is used.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindMultiLineXmlComment
description: Detect `/** */` style XML documentation comments that could use the `///` single-line syntax for consistency.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindNonConstantStaticFieldsVisible
displayName: Non-constant static fields should not be visible
description: Public static fields that are not `const` or `readonly` can be modified by any code, breaking encapsulation. Make them `readonly` or use a property.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindNonDeterministicEndOfLine
description: Detect string literals containing `\n` that may behave differently across platforms. Consider using `Environment.NewLine` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindNonFlagsEnumWithFlagsAttribute
description: Detect enums marked with `[Flags]` whose values are not powers of two, indicating they are not truly flags enums.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindNotNullIfNotNullAttribute
description: Detect methods with nullable return types depending on nullable parameters that lack `[NotNullIfNotNull]` attribute.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindObserveAsyncResult
description: Detect calls to async methods where the returned Task is not awaited, assigned, or otherwise observed. Unobserved tasks may silently swallow exceptions.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindObsoleteWithoutMessage
description: The `[Obsolete]` attribute should include a message explaining why the member is obsolete and what to use instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindOverrideChangesParameterDefaults
displayName: Find overrides that change parameter defaults
description: Detect `override` methods with default parameter values. Overrides should not change defaults from the base method as this causes confusing behavior depending on the reference type.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindPreferCollectionAbstraction
displayName: Find concrete collection in public API
description: Detect public method parameters or return types that use concrete collection types like `List<T>` instead of `IList<T>` or `IEnumerable<T>`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindPrimaryConstructorReadonly
description: Detect primary constructor parameters that are reassigned in the class body. Primary constructor parameters should be treated as readonly.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindRawStringImplicitEndOfLine
displayName: Find raw string with implicit end of line
description: Detect raw string literals (`"""..."""`) that contain implicit end-of-line characters which may behave differently across platforms.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindReadOnlyStructMembers
displayName: Find struct member that could be readonly
description: Detect struct methods and properties that don't modify state and could be marked `readonly` to prevent defensive copies.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindRedundantArgumentValue
description: Detect named arguments that explicitly pass a default value. Removing them simplifies the call.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindSenderNullForStaticEvents
displayName: Find static event with non-null sender
description: Detect static event invocations that pass `this` as the sender. Static events should use `null` as the sender.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindSingleLineXmlComment
displayName: Find multi-line XML doc comment style
description: Detect `/** ... */` style XML doc comments. Use `///` single-line style instead for consistency.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindSpanEqualityOperator
description: Detect `==` or `!=` operators on `Span<T>` or `ReadOnlySpan<T>`. Use `SequenceEqual` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindStreamReadIgnored
description: Detect `Stream.Read()` calls where the return value (bytes read) is not used. This can lead to incomplete reads.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindStringFormatConstant
description: Detect non-constant format strings passed to `string.Format`. Use a constant to prevent format string injection.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindTaskInUsing
displayName: Find unawaited task in using statement
description: Detect `using` statements where a Task is not awaited, which can cause premature disposal before the task completes.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindThreadStaticOnInstanceField
displayName: Do not use ThreadStatic on instance fields
description: `[ThreadStatic]` only works on static fields. Using it on instance fields has no effect.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindThrowIfNullWithNonNullable
displayName: Find ThrowIfNull with value type argument
description: Detect `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull` called with value type parameters that can never be null.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindTypeNameMatchesNamespace
description: Detect type names that match their containing namespace, which can cause ambiguous references.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindTypeShouldNotExtendApplicationException
description: Do not create custom exceptions that inherit from `ApplicationException`. Inherit from `Exception` or a more specific exception type.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseCallerArgumentExpression
description: Detect `nameof(param)` passed to parameters marked with `[CallerArgumentExpression]`. The attribute fills the value automatically.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseDateTimeOffsetInsteadOfDateTime
description: Detect `DateTime.Now` and `DateTime.UtcNow` usage. Use `DateTimeOffset` instead for unambiguous time representation across time zones.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseDebuggerDisplayAttribute
description: Detect classes that override `ToString()` but lack `[DebuggerDisplay]` attribute for debugger integration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseDefaultParameterValue
description: Detect `[DefaultValue]` on method parameters. Use `[DefaultParameterValue]` instead, as `[DefaultValue]` is for component model metadata only.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseElementAccessInsteadOfLinq
displayName: Find ElementAt() that could use indexer
description: Detect LINQ `.ElementAt(index)` calls that could be replaced with direct indexer access `[index]`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseEqualsMethodInsteadOfOperator
displayName: Find == comparison that should use Equals()
description: Detect `==` comparisons on reference types that override `Equals`. Using `==` may compare references instead of values.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseExplicitEnumValue
displayName: Find integer 0 used instead of named enum value
description: Detect usage of integer literal `0` where a named enum member should be used for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseFormatProviderInToString
description: Detect calls to culture-sensitive methods like `int.Parse`, `double.Parse` without an explicit `IFormatProvider` or `CultureInfo`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseIFormatProvider
description: Detect `int.Parse(str)` and similar calls without an `IFormatProvider` parameter. Use `CultureInfo.InvariantCulture` for culture-independent parsing.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseLangwordInXmlComment
displayName: Find missing langword in XML comment
description: Detect XML doc comments that reference `null`, `true`, `false` as plain text instead of using `<see langword="..."/>`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseLazyInitializerEnsureInitialize
description: Detect `Interlocked.CompareExchange(ref field, new T(), null)` pattern. Use `LazyInitializer.EnsureInitialized` for cleaner lazy initialization.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseListPatternMatching
description: Detect `.Length == 0` or `.Count == 0` checks that could use list patterns like `is []` in C# 11+.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseNamedParameter
displayName: Find boolean literal argument without name
description: Detect boolean literal arguments (`true`/`false`) passed without named parameters. Named arguments improve readability.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseOperatingSystemMethods
displayName: Use OperatingSystem methods instead of RuntimeInformation
description: Use `OperatingSystem.IsWindows()` and similar methods instead of `RuntimeInformation.IsOSPlatform()`. The OperatingSystem methods are more concise and can be optimized by the JIT.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseProcessStartWithStartInfo
description: Detect `Process.Start("filename")` which should use the `ProcessStartInfo` overload for explicit control over `UseShellExecute` and other settings.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseRecordClassExplicitly
description: Detect `record` declarations that should use `record class` explicitly to clarify that they are reference types.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseRegexOptions
description: Detect `new Regex()` or `Regex.IsMatch()` without `RegexOptions.ExplicitCapture`. Using this option avoids unnecessary unnamed captures.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseShellExecuteFalseWhenRedirecting
description: Detect `ProcessStartInfo` that sets `RedirectStandard*` without explicitly setting `UseShellExecute = false`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseShellExecuteNotSet
description: Detect `new ProcessStartInfo()` without explicitly setting `UseShellExecute`. The default changed between .NET Framework (true) and .NET Core (false).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseStringComparer
description: Detect `Dictionary<string, T>` or `HashSet<string>` created without an explicit `StringComparer`. Use `StringComparer.Ordinal` or `StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseStringCreateInsteadOfConcat
description: Detect `FormattableString` usage. Consider using `String.Create` on .NET 6+ for better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseStringEqualsInsteadOfIsPattern
description: Detect `x is "literal"` patterns that should use `string.Equals` with explicit `StringComparison` for culture-aware or case-insensitive comparisons.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseSystemThreadingLock
displayName: Use System.Threading.Lock instead of object for locking
description: In .NET 9+, use `System.Threading.Lock` instead of `object` for lock objects. The dedicated Lock type provides better performance.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseTaskUnwrap
description: Detect `await await` pattern which can be replaced with `.Unwrap()` for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindUseTimeProviderInsteadOfCustom
description: Detect interfaces or abstract classes that appear to be custom time providers. Use `System.TimeProvider` (available in .NET 8+) instead.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.FindValidateArgumentsBeforeYield
displayName: Find argument validation in iterator method
description: Detect iterator methods that validate arguments after `yield return`. Argument validation in iterators is deferred until enumeration begins.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ImplementExceptionConstructors
description: Ensure custom exception classes implement standard constructors.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ImplementNonGenericCounterpart
description: Implement non-generic interface when implementing generic counterpart.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.InvalidArgumentNullCheck
description: Fix invalid argument null check patterns.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MakeClassSealed
description: A class that has only private constructors should be marked as sealed.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MakeClassStatic
description: Make classes that contain only static members static.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MakeFieldReadOnly
description: Make field read-only when it is only assigned in the constructor or initializer.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MakeMethodExtensionMethod
description: Convert a static method to an extension method where appropriate.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MarkLocalVariableAsConst
description: Mark local variable as const when its value never changes.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MarkTypeWithDebuggerDisplay
description: Add DebuggerDisplay attribute to publicly visible types to improve debugging experience.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.MergePreprocessorDirectives
description: Merge consecutive preprocessor directives that can be combined into a single directive.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.NormalizeEnumFlagValue
displayName: Normalize format of enum flag value
description: Normalize the format of Flags enum values.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.OrderModifiers
description: Reorder modifiers to the canonical C# order: access, new, abstract/virtual/override/sealed, static, readonly, extern, unsafe, volatile, async, partial, const.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.OrderNamedArguments
description: Reorder named arguments to match parameter order.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.OrderTypeParameterConstraints
description: Order type parameter constraints consistently.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.OverridingMemberShouldNotChangeParams
displayName: Overriding member should not change 'params' modifier
description: An overriding member should not add or remove the 'params' modifier compared to its base declaration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ParameterNameDiffersFromBase
description: Rename parameter to match base class or interface definition.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ParenthesizeNotPattern
description: Add parentheses to `not A or B` → `(not A) or B` to clarify that `not` binds tighter than `or`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.PreferNullCheckOverTypeCheck
displayName: Prefer null check over type check
description: Replace `x is object` with `x is not null` for clarity.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.SimplifyBooleanLogic
description: Simplify `x || true` to `true`, `x && false` to `false`, `x || false` to `x`, and `x && true` to `x`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.SortEnumMembers
description: Sort enum members by their resolved constant value.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.SplitVariableDeclaration
description: Split multi-variable declarations into separate declarations.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.StaticMemberInGenericType
displayName: Static member in generic type should use a type parameter
description: Find static members in generic types that do not use any of the type's type parameters.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.StyleCodeQuality
description: Code style modernization recipes for C#.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UnusedParameter
description: Rename unused lambda parameters to discard (_).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UnusedTypeParameter
description: Flag type parameters that are not used.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseAsyncAwait
description: Add async/await to methods that return Task but don't use await.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseAttributeUsageAttribute
description: Add AttributeUsage to custom attribute classes.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseAutoProperty
description: Use auto property instead of property with backing field.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

displayName: Use block body or expression body
description: Convert between block body and expression body for members.

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseCoalesceExpressionFromNullCheck
description: Convert null-check conditional to null-coalescing expression.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseCollectionExpression
description: Replace array/list creation with collection expressions (C# 12).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseConstantInsteadOfField
description: Convert `static readonly` fields with literal initializers to `const`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseElementAccess
description: Use indexer instead of First()/Last()/ElementAt() when the collection supports indexer access.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseEnumFieldExplicitly
description: Use named enum field instead of cast integer value.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseEventArgsEmpty
description: Replace `new EventArgs()` with `EventArgs.Empty`. The static `EventArgs.Empty` field avoids unnecessary allocations.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseEventArgsEmptyForNull
description: Replace `null` with `EventArgs.Empty` when raising events. Passing `null` for EventArgs can cause NullReferenceException in event handlers.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseEventHandlerT
description: Use generic EventHandler<T> instead of custom delegate types.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseExplicitTypeInsteadOfVar
displayName: Use explicit type instead of var
description: Use explicit type instead of `var` when the type is not evident.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseExplicitlyTypedArray
description: Use explicitly or implicitly typed array.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseFileScopedNamespace
description: Detect block-scoped namespace declarations that could use file-scoped syntax (C# 10).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseMethodChaining
description: Chain consecutive method calls on the same receiver into a fluent chain.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseMethodGroupConversion
description: Replace `x => Foo(x)` with `Foo` where method group conversion applies.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UsePredefinedType
description: Use predefined type keyword (e.g., int instead of Int32).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UsePrimaryConstructor
description: Convert classes with a single constructor into primary constructor syntax (C# 12).
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseReadOnlyAutoProperty
description: Use read-only auto property when the setter is never used.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseStringContains
displayName: Use string.Contains instead of IndexOf comparison
description: Replace `s.IndexOf(x) >= 0` with `s.Contains(x)` and `s.IndexOf(x) == -1` with `!s.Contains(x)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseStringIsNullOrEmpty
description: Replace `s == null || s == ""` and `s == null || s.Length == 0` with `string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseStringLengthComparison
displayName: Use string.Length instead of comparison with empty string
description: Replace `s == ""` with `s.Length == 0` and `s != ""` with `s.Length != 0`.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseThisForEventSender
description: Replace `null` with `this` as the sender argument when raising instance events. The sender should be the object raising the event.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseUsingDeclaration
description: Convert using statement to using declaration.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseVarInForEach
displayName: Use var instead of explicit type in foreach
description: Replace explicit type in foreach with var when type is evident.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.UseVarOrExplicitType
description: Enforce consistent use of 'var' or explicit type in local variable declarations.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ValidateArgumentsCorrectly
description: Ensure argument validation in iterator methods runs immediately by flagging iterator methods that contain argument validation.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.CodeQuality.Style.ValueTypeIsNeverEqualToNull
displayName: Value type is never equal to null
description: Replace null with default in comparisons of value types.
category3Description: Recipes for improving C# code quality

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNet.UpgradeAspNetFrameworkToCore
displayName: Migrate ASP.NET Framework to ASP.NET Core
description: Migrate ASP.NET Framework (System.Web.Mvc, System.Web.Http) types to their ASP.NET Core equivalents. Based on the .NET Upgrade Assistant's UA0002 and UA0010 diagnostics. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/migration/proper-to-2x.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.FindBuildWebHost
description: Flags `BuildWebHost` method declarations that should be renamed to `CreateWebHostBuilder` and refactored for ASP.NET Core 2.1.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.FindIAuthenticationManager
description: Flags references to `IAuthenticationManager` which was removed in ASP.NET Core 2.0. Use `HttpContext` extension methods from `Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.FindSetCompatibilityVersion
description: Flags `SetCompatibilityVersion` calls. This method is a no-op in ASP.NET Core 3.0+ and should be removed during migration.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.FindUseKestrelWithConfig
description: Flags `UseKestrel` calls with configuration lambdas that should be replaced with `ConfigureKestrel` to avoid conflicts with the IIS in-process hosting model.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.UpgradeToAspNetCore20
description: Migrate ASP.NET Core 1.x projects to ASP.NET Core 2.0, applying authentication and Identity changes. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/migration/1x-to-2x/identity-2x.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.UpgradeToAspNetCore21
description: Migrate ASP.NET Core 2.0 projects to ASP.NET Core 2.1, including host builder changes and obsolete API replacements. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/migration/20-to-21.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.UpgradeToAspNetCore22
description: Migrate ASP.NET Core 2.1 projects to ASP.NET Core 2.2, including Kestrel configuration and logging changes. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/migration/21-to-22.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.UseGetExternalAuthenticationSchemesAsync
description: Replace `GetExternalAuthenticationSchemes()` with `GetExternalAuthenticationSchemesAsync()`. The synchronous method was removed in ASP.NET Core 2.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.UseHttpContextAuthExtensions
description: Replace `HttpContext.Authentication.Method(...)` calls with `HttpContext.Method(...)` extension methods. The `IAuthenticationManager` interface was removed in ASP.NET Core 2.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore2.UseUseAuthentication
description: Replace `app.UseIdentity()` with `app.UseAuthentication()`. The `UseIdentity` method was removed in ASP.NET Core 2.0 in favor of `UseAuthentication`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.FindAddMvc
description: Flags `AddMvc()` calls that should be replaced with more specific service registrations (`AddControllers`, `AddControllersWithViews`, or `AddRazorPages`) in ASP.NET Core 3.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.FindIApplicationLifetime
description: Flags usages of `IApplicationLifetime` which should be replaced with `IHostApplicationLifetime` in ASP.NET Core 3.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.FindIHostingEnvironment
description: Flags usages of `IHostingEnvironment` which should be replaced with `IWebHostEnvironment` in ASP.NET Core 3.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.FindNewtonsoftJsonUsage
displayName: Find Newtonsoft.Json usage in ASP.NET Core
description: Flags `JsonConvert` and other `Newtonsoft.Json` usage. ASP.NET Core 3.0 uses `System.Text.Json` by default.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.FindUseMvcOrUseSignalR
description: Flags `UseMvc()` and `UseSignalR()` calls that should be replaced with endpoint routing (`UseRouting()` + `UseEndpoints()`) in ASP.NET Core 3.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.FindWebHostBuilder
description: Flags `WebHostBuilder` and `WebHost.CreateDefaultBuilder` usage that should migrate to the Generic Host pattern in ASP.NET Core 3.0+.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.UpgradeToAspNetCore30
description: Migrate ASP.NET Core 2.2 projects to ASP.NET Core 3.0, including endpoint routing, Generic Host, and System.Text.Json changes. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/migration/22-to-30.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.AspNetCore3.UseLoggerFactoryCreate
description: Rewrites the obsolete `new LoggerFactory()` plus `ILoggerFactory.Add*()` provider configuration to `LoggerFactory.Create(builder => ...)`, moving each provider registration onto the `ILoggingBuilder`. Handles both the chained form and the form where registration calls follow the declaration as separate statements. Argument shapes with no `ILoggingBuilder` equivalent are left in place and flagged for manual migration.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net10.FindActivitySampling
description: Finds usages of `ActivitySamplingResult.PropagationData` which has changed behavior in .NET 10. Activities with a recorded parent and PropagationData sampling no longer set `Activity.Recorded = true`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 10

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net10.FindBackgroundServiceExecuteAsync
description: Finds methods that override `ExecuteAsync` from `BackgroundService`. In .NET 10, the entire method runs on a background thread; synchronous code before the first `await` no longer blocks host startup.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 10

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net10.FindBufferedStreamWriteByte
description: Finds calls to `BufferedStream.WriteByte()` which no longer performs an implicit flush when the internal buffer is full in .NET 10. Call `Flush()` explicitly if needed.
