description: Replace `if (value < 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value))` guard clauses with `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegative(value)`. Also handles reversed `0 > value`. Available since .NET 7.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 7

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net7.UseThrowIfNegativeOrZero
description: Replace `if (value <= 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value))` guard clauses with `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfNegativeOrZero(value)`. Also handles reversed `0 >= value`. Available since .NET 7.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 7

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net7.UseThrowIfNullOrEmpty
description: Replace `if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(s)) throw new ArgumentException("...", nameof(s))` guard clauses with `ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrEmpty(s)`. Available since .NET 7.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 7

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindAddContext
description: Finds calls to `JsonSerializerOptions.AddContext<T>()` which is obsolete in .NET 8 (SYSLIB0049). Use `TypeInfoResolverChain` or `TypeInfoResolver` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindAesGcmOldConstructor
description: Finds `new AesGcm(key)` constructor calls without an explicit tag size parameter. In .NET 8, the single-argument constructor is obsolete (SYSLIB0053). Use `new AesGcm(key, tagSizeInBytes)` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindFormatterBasedSerialization
description: Finds usage of formatter-based serialization types (`FormatterConverter`, `IFormatter`, `ObjectIDGenerator`, `ObjectManager`, `SurrogateSelector`, `SerializationInfo`, `StreamingContext`). These are obsolete in .NET 8 (SYSLIB0050/0051).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindFrozenCollection
displayName: Find ToImmutable*() that could use Frozen collections
description: Finds usages of `ToImmutableDictionary()` and `ToImmutableHashSet()`. In .NET 8+, `ToFrozenDictionary()` and `ToFrozenSet()` provide better read performance.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindRegexCompileToAssembly
description: Finds usage of `Regex.CompileToAssembly()` and `RegexCompilationInfo`. These are obsolete in .NET 8 (SYSLIB0052). Use the Regex source generator instead.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindSerializationConstructors
description: Finds legacy serialization constructors `.ctor(SerializationInfo, StreamingContext)` which are obsolete in .NET 8 (SYSLIB0051). The `ISerializable` pattern is no longer recommended.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.FindTimeAbstraction
description: Finds usages of `DateTime.Now`, `DateTime.UtcNow`, `DateTimeOffset.Now`, and `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`. In .NET 8+, `TimeProvider` is the recommended abstraction for time.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.UpgradeToDotNet8
description: Migrate C# projects to .NET 8, applying necessary API changes. Includes all .NET 7 migration steps. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/compatibility/8.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.UseThrowIfGreaterThan
description: Replace `if (value > other) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value))` guard clauses with `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfGreaterThan(value, other)`. Also handles reversed `other < value` and `>=`/`ThrowIfGreaterThanOrEqual`. Available since .NET 8.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.UseThrowIfLessThan
description: Replace `if (value < other) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value))` guard clauses with `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfLessThan(value, other)`. Also handles reversed `other > value` and `<=`/`ThrowIfLessThanOrEqual`. Available since .NET 8.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.UseThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace
description: Replace `if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s)) throw new ArgumentException("...", nameof(s))` guard clauses with `ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace(s)`. Available since .NET 8.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.UseThrowIfZero
description: Replace `if (value == 0) throw new ArgumentOutOfRangeException(nameof(value))` guard clauses with `ArgumentOutOfRangeException.ThrowIfZero(value)`. Also handles reversed `0 == value`. Available since .NET 8.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net8.UseTimeProvider
displayName: Use TimeProvider instead of DateTime/DateTimeOffset static properties
description: Replace `DateTime.UtcNow`, `DateTime.Now`, `DateTimeOffset.UtcNow`, and `DateTimeOffset.Now` with `TimeProvider.System.GetUtcNow()`/`GetLocalNow()` equivalents. TimeProvider enables testability and consistent time sources. Available since .NET 8.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 8

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindAsyncEnumerableLinqAmbiguity
displayName: Find LINQ ambiguities introduced by .NET 9 `IAsyncEnumerable` extensions
description: .NET 9 added LINQ extension methods on `IAsyncEnumerable<T>`. Types implementing both `IQueryable<T>` and `IAsyncEnumerable<T>` (notably EF Core `DbSet<T>`) now produce ambiguous `Where`/`Select`/`FirstOrDefault`/etc. calls. Flags such calls for manual disambiguation (typically by inserting `.AsQueryable()`).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindAuthenticationManager
description: Finds usages of `AuthenticationManager` which is not supported in .NET 9 (SYSLIB0009). Methods will no-op or throw `PlatformNotSupportedException`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindBinaryFormatter
description: Finds usages of `BinaryFormatter` which always throws `NotSupportedException` in .NET 9. Migrate to a different serializer such as `System.Text.Json`, `XmlSerializer`, or `DataContractSerializer`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindBinaryReaderReadString
description: Finds calls to `BinaryReader.ReadString()` which now returns the Unicode replacement character (\uFFFD) for malformed UTF-8 byte sequences in .NET 9, instead of the previous behavior. Verify your code handles the replacement character correctly.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindDistributedCache
description: Finds usages of `IDistributedCache`. In .NET 9, `HybridCache` is the recommended replacement with L1/L2 caching, stampede protection, and tag-based invalidation.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindEnumConverter
description: Finds `new EnumConverter()` constructor calls. In .NET 9, `EnumConverter` validates that the registered type is actually an enum and throws `ArgumentException` if not.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindExecuteUpdateSync
description: Finds usages of synchronous `ExecuteUpdate()` and `ExecuteDelete()` which were removed in EF Core 9. Use `ExecuteUpdateAsync`/`ExecuteDeleteAsync` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindHttpClientHandlerCast
description: Finds usages of `HttpClientHandler` which may break when `HttpClientFactory` switches its default handler to `SocketsHttpHandler` in .NET 9.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindHttpListenerRequestUserAgent
description: Finds accesses to `HttpListenerRequest.UserAgent` which changed from `string` to `string?` in .NET 9. Code that assumes `UserAgent` is non-null may throw `NullReferenceException`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindImplicitAuthenticationDefault
displayName: Find implicit authentication default scheme (ASP.NET Core 9)
description: Finds calls to `AddAuthentication()` with no arguments. In .NET 9, a single registered authentication scheme is no longer automatically used as the default.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindInMemoryDirectoryInfo
description: Finds `new InMemoryDirectoryInfo()` constructor calls. In .NET 9, `rootDir` is prepended to file paths that don't start with the `rootDir`, which may change file matching behavior.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindIncrementingPollingCounter
description: Finds `new IncrementingPollingCounter()` constructor calls. In .NET 9, the initial callback invocation is asynchronous instead of synchronous, which may change timing behavior.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindJsonDocumentNullable
description: Finds `JsonSerializer.Deserialize()` calls. In .NET 9, nullable `JsonDocument` properties now deserialize to a `JsonDocument` with `RootElement.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Null` instead of being `null`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindJsonStringEnumConverter
description: Finds usages of the non-generic `JsonStringEnumConverter`. In .NET 9, the generic `JsonStringEnumConverter<TEnum>` is preferred for AOT compatibility.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindRuntimeHelpersGetSubArray
description: Finds calls to `RuntimeHelpers.GetSubArray()` which may return a different array type in .NET 9. Code that depends on the runtime type of the returned array may break.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindSafeEvpPKeyHandleDuplicate
description: Finds calls to `SafeEvpPKeyHandle.DuplicateHandle()`. In .NET 9, this method now increments the reference count instead of creating a deep copy, which may affect handle lifetime.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindServicePointManager
description: Finds usages of `ServicePointManager` which is fully obsolete in .NET 9 (SYSLIB0014). Settings on `ServicePointManager` don't affect `SslStream` or `HttpClient`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindSwashbuckle
displayName: Find Swashbuckle usage (ASP.NET Core 9 built-in OpenAPI)
description: Finds usages of Swashbuckle APIs (`AddSwaggerGen`, `UseSwagger`, `UseSwaggerUI`). .NET 9 includes built-in OpenAPI support. Consider migrating to `AddOpenApi()`/`MapOpenApi()`.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindX509CertificateConstructors
description: Finds usages of `X509Certificate2` and `X509Certificate` constructors that accept binary content or file paths, which are obsolete in .NET 9 (SYSLIB0057). Use `X509CertificateLoader` methods instead.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindZipArchiveCompressionLevel
description: Finds `ZipArchive.CreateEntry()` and `ZipFileExtensions.CreateEntryFromFile()` calls with a `CompressionLevel` parameter. In .NET 9, the `CompressionLevel` value now sets general-purpose bit flags in the ZIP central directory header, which may affect interoperability.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.FindZipArchiveEntryEncoding
description: Finds access to `ZipArchiveEntry.Name`, `FullName`, or `Comment` properties. In .NET 9, these now respect the UTF-8 flag in ZIP entries, which may change decoded values.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.MigrateSwashbuckleToOpenApi
description: Migrate from Swashbuckle to the built-in OpenAPI support in ASP.NET Core 10+. Replaces `AddSwaggerGen()` with `AddOpenApi()`, `UseSwaggerUI()` with `MapOpenApi()`, removes `UseSwagger()`, removes Swashbuckle packages, and adds `Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi`. Only fires when every project targets net10.0+ (the version that ships Microsoft.OpenApi 2.x with its flattened type namespaces).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.RemoveConfigureAwaitFalse
description: Remove `.ConfigureAwait(false)` calls that are unnecessary in ASP.NET Core and modern .NET applications (no SynchronizationContext). Do not apply to library code targeting .NET Framework.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UpgradeToDotNet9
description: Migrate C# projects to .NET 9, applying necessary API changes. Includes all .NET 7 and .NET 8 migration steps. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/core/compatibility/9.0.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseEscapeSequenceE
description: Replace `\u001b` and `\x1b` escape sequences with `\e`. C# 13 introduced `\e` as a dedicated escape sequence for the escape character (U+001B).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseFrozenCollections
displayName: Use Frozen collections instead of Immutable
description: Replace `ToImmutableDictionary()` with `ToFrozenDictionary()` and `ToImmutableHashSet()` with `ToFrozenSet()`. Frozen collections (.NET 8+) provide better read performance for collections populated once and read many times.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseGuidCreateVersion7
description: Replace `Guid.NewGuid()` with `Guid.CreateVersion7()`. Version 7 GUIDs are time-ordered and better for database primary keys, indexing, and sorting. Available since .NET 9.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseLinqAggregateBy
description: Replace `collection.GroupBy(keySelector).ToDictionary(g => g.Key, g => g.Aggregate(seed, func))` with `collection.AggregateBy(keySelector, seed, func).ToDictionary()`. Available since .NET 9.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseLinqCountBy
description: Replace `collection.GroupBy(selector).Select(g => g.Count())` with `collection.CountBy(selector)`. Available since .NET 9.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseLinqIndex
description: Replace `collection.Select((item, index) => (index, item))` with `collection.Index()`. Available since .NET 9.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseLockObject
description: Replace `object` fields initialized with `new object()` with `System.Threading.Lock` initialized with `new()`. The Lock type provides better performance with the lock statement. Available since .NET 9.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseMapStaticAssets
description: Replace `UseStaticFiles()` with `MapStaticAssets()` for ASP.NET Core 9. Only applies when the receiver supports `IEndpointRouteBuilder` (WebApplication / minimal hosting). Skips Startup.cs patterns using `IApplicationBuilder` where `MapStaticAssets` is not available.
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseTaskCompletedTask
description: Replace `Task.FromResult(0)`, `Task.FromResult(true)`, and `Task.FromResult(false)` with `Task.CompletedTask` when the return type is `Task` (not `Task<T>`).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseVolatileReadWrite
description: Replace `Thread.VolatileRead` and `Thread.VolatileWrite` with `Volatile.Read` and `Volatile.Write`. The Thread methods are obsolete in .NET 9 (SYSLIB0054).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.Net9.UseX509CertificateLoader
description: Replace `new X509Certificate2(path, password)` with `X509CertificateLoader.LoadPkcs12FromFile(path, password)`. The two-argument X509Certificate2 constructor is obsolete in .NET 9 (SYSLIB0057).
category3Description: Recipes for migrating to .NET 9

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.AddOverrideToDbParameterPrecisionScale
description: As of .NET Framework 4.5.1, `DbParameter.Precision` and `DbParameter.Scale` are public virtual properties. Adds the `override` modifier to `Precision`/`Scale` properties declared on a `DbParameter` subclass so the provider compiles against the new target.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindAsyncCurrentCultureFlow
description: Finds uses of `CurrentCulture`/`CurrentUICulture`, which flow across async tasks (via `ExecutionContext`) when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6 (`Switch.System.Globalization.NoAsyncCurrentCulture` to revert). Review code that sets the culture and relies on it NOT propagating to async continuations.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindClaimsIdentityActorClone
description: Finds `ClaimsIdentity(IIdentity, ...)` constructions, which clone the `Actor` instead of attaching it by reference when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6.2 (`Switch.System.Security.ClaimsIdentity.SetActorAsReferenceWhenCopyingClaimsIdentity` to revert).
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindDataContractJsonSerializerEscaping
description: DataContractJsonSerializer control-character escaping becomes ECMAScript V6/V8-compatible when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7 (Switch.System.Runtime.Serialization.DoNotUseECMAScriptV6EscapeControlCharacter to revert). Review consumers that depend on the old escaping.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindDataObjectGetDataHtml
description: DataObject.GetData retrieves HTML-format clipboard data as UTF-8 instead of ASCII when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.5.2. Remove any manual UTF-8 conversion workaround.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindDeflateStreamNativeDecompression
description: Flag usages of `DeflateStream` and `GZipStream`, whose decompression switches to native Windows APIs when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7.2.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindFipsManagedCryptoThrow
displayName: Find managed crypto classes (FIPS mode behavior change)
description: Flag usages of managed cryptography classes whose FIPS-enforced-mode throwing behavior changes when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.8.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindHttpRuntimeAppDomainAppPath
description: HttpRuntime.AppDomainAppPath throws NullReferenceException (instead of ArgumentNullException) for paths with null characters when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6.2; this reverts to ArgumentNullException at 4.7. Review exception handling.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindIconToBitmapPngFrames
description: Icon.ToBitmap succeeds on icons containing PNG frames when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6 (previously threw ArgumentOutOfRangeException; Switch.System.Drawing.DontSupportPngFramesInIcons to restore throwing). Review Icon.ToBitmap usage.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindListForEachDuringMutation
description: Finds calls to `List<T>.ForEach`, which throws `InvalidOperationException` if the collection is modified during enumeration when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.5 (previously the modification was silently ignored).
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindObsoleteEncoderParameterCtor
description: Finds uses of the obsolete `EncoderParameter(Encoder, int, int, int, int)` constructor (obsolete as of .NET Framework 4.5). Use the `EncoderParameter(Encoder, int, EncoderParameterValueType, IntPtr)` overload instead.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindObsoleteMachineKeyEncryption
description: Finds references to `System.Web.Security.MachineKey`, whose `Encode`/`Decode` methods are obsolete as of .NET Framework 4.5. Use `MachineKey.Protect`/`MachineKey.Unprotect` instead.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindObsoleteWorkflowTypes
description: Finds `using System.Workflow.*` directives. Windows Workflow Foundation 3.x is obsolete as of .NET Framework 4.5; migrate to the WF 4 model under `System.Activities.*`.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindPathNormalizationChange
description: Finds uses of `System.IO.Path`, whose normalization defers to the OS and supports long (>260 char) paths when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6.2 (`Switch.System.IO.UseLegacyPathHandling` / `Switch.System.IO.BlockLongPaths` to revert). Review path handling and `PathTooLongException` assumptions.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindRSACngImportParameters
description: Flag usages of `RSACng`, whose handling of non-standard RSA key sizes changes when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6.2.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindSerialPortThreadException
description: SerialPort no longer terminates the process when its background thread hits an OS exception when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7.1 (Switch.System.IO.Ports.DoNotCatchSerialStreamThreadExceptions to revert). Review SerialPort error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindServiceBaseRunOnStart
description: ServiceBase.Run now propagates exceptions thrown from OnStart when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7.1 (Switch.System.ServiceProcess.DontThrowExceptionsOnStart to revert). Review service startup error handling.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindServicePointManagerSecurityProtocol
description: Finds usages of `System.Net.ServicePointManager` whose TLS behavior changes when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6+ (SchUseStrongCrypto) and 4.7+ (SystemDefault protocol). The opt-out switches are `Switch.System.Net.DontEnableSchUseStrongCrypto` and `Switch.System.Net.DontEnableSystemDefaultTlsVersions`.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindSignedXmlDefaultHash
description: Flag usages of `SignedXml` and `CmsSigner`, whose default hash algorithm changes from SHA-1 to SHA-256 when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7.1.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindSslStreamTlsAlerts
description: Flag usages of `SslStream`, whose TLS alert handling behavior changes when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindUriParsingChange
description: Finds `System.Uri` construction whose parsing changed when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.5 (RFC 3987) and 4.7.2 (RFC 3986 reserved-character handling and Unicode bidi characters). Review URI construction and normalization for behavior differences.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindWpfGridStarAllocation
description: The WPF Grid star-column space allocation algorithm was replaced when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.7 (Switch.System.Windows.Controls.Grid.StarDefinitionsCanExceedAvailableSpace=true restores the old algorithm). Review layouts that depend on the previous star-sizing behavior.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindXmlWriterInvalidSurrogate
description: Finds `XmlWriter` usage. The `Write*` methods throw `ArgumentException` on invalid surrogate pairs when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6 (previously they were written through). Review XmlWriter usage that may emit lone surrogates.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.FindZipFileEntrySeparator
description: Flag usages of `ZipFile` and `ZipArchiveEntry`, whose entry path separator changes when retargeting to .NET Framework 4.6.1.
category3Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.UpgradeToNetFramework45
description: Retargets a .NET Framework 4.0 project to 4.5. Updates `<TargetFrameworkVersion>` to `v4.5` (legacy csproj), `<TargetFramework>` to `net45` (SDK-style csproj), the `<supportedRuntime sku>` in app.config, and the `targetFramework` attribute in web.config. Retargeting to 4.5 enables RFC 3987 `System.Uri` parsing (stricter normalization/validation), C# 5 per-iteration `foreach` variable scoping, and obsoletes `MachineKey.Encode`/`Decode` (use `MachineKey.Protect`/`Unprotect`) and the `System.Workflow.*` (WF 3.x) types (use `System.Activities.*`). See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/migration-guide/retargeting/4.5.x.
category2Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.UpgradeToNetFramework451
description: Retargets a .NET Framework 4.5 project to 4.5.1. Updates `<TargetFrameworkVersion>` to `v4.5.1`, `<TargetFramework>` to `net451`, the app.config `<supportedRuntime sku>`, and the web.config `targetFramework`. Includes all earlier steps (4.0 -> 4.5). Notable retargeting changes at 4.5.1: rebuilt ADO.NET providers must add `override` to `DbParameter.Precision`/`Scale`; WPF two-way binding to a non-public setter now throws `InvalidOperationException`. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/migration-guide/retargeting/4.5.x.
category2Description: Recipes for retargeting .NET Framework projects between 4.x minor versions
category3Description: Recipes for migrating between versions

name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.UpgradeToNetFramework452
description: Retargets a .NET Framework 4.5.1 project to 4.5.2. Updates `<TargetFrameworkVersion>` to `v4.5.2`, `<TargetFramework>` to `net452`, the app.config `<supportedRuntime sku>`, and the web.config `targetFramework`. name: OpenRewrite.Recipes.CSharp.Migration.Dotnet.NetFramework.UpgradeToNetFramework46
description: Retargets a .NET Framework 4.5.2 project to 4.6. Updates `<TargetFrameworkVersion>` to `v4.6`, `<TargetFramework>` to `net46`, the app.config `<supportedRuntime sku>`, and the web.config `targetFramework`. Includes all earlier steps (4.0 -> 4.5.2). 4.6 is where `<AppContextSwitchOverrides>` is introduced. Notable retargeting changes: TLS now restricts to 1.0/1.1/1.2 and drops SSL3/RC4 (opt out via `Switch.System.Net.DontEnableSchUseStrongCrypto=true`); certificate EKU validation is added; `CurrentCulture`/`CurrentUICulture` flow across async tasks (`Switch.System.Globalization.NoAsyncCurrentCulture=true`); the 64-bit RyuJIT replaces the legacy JIT (`<useLegacyJit enabled="1"/>` to revert); `XmlWriter` throws on invalid surrogate pairs. The accompanying `Find` recipe flags `ServicePointManager`/TLS code for review. See https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/framework/migration-guide/retargeting/4.6.x.

Includes all earlier steps (4.0 -> 4.6). Notable retargeting changes at 4.6.1: `ZipArchiveEntry.FullName` uses `/` separators (`Switch.System.IO.Compression.ZipFile.UseBackslash=true` to revert); WCF transport security supports CNG-stored certificates; `X509CertificateClaimSet.FindClaims` matches all SAN DNS entries (`Switch.System.IdentityModel.DisableMultipleDNSEntriesInSANCertificate=true`). Notable retargeting changes at 4.6.2: path normalization defers to the OS and supports long (>260 char) paths (`Switch.System.IO.UseLegacyPathHandling=true` / `Switch.System.IO.BlockLongPaths=true` to revert); `ClaimsIdentity` ctors clone the `Actor` (`Switch.System.Security.ClaimsIdentity.SetActorAsReferenceWhenCopyingClaimsIdentity=true`); `RSACng` accepts non-standard key sizes and `SignedXml.GetPublicKey` returns `RSACng`. description: The `sndhdr` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `filetype` or audio libraries like `pydub` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSocketGetFQDN
description: Find usage of `socket.getfqdn()` which can be slow and unreliable. Consider using `socket.gethostname()` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSpwdModule
description: The `spwd` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. There is no direct replacement.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSslMatchHostname
description: Find usage of the deprecated `ssl.match_hostname()` function which was removed in Python 3.12. Use `ssl.SSLContext.check_hostname` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSunauModule
description: The `sunau` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `soundfile` or `pydub` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindSysCoroutineWrapper
description: `sys.set_coroutine_wrapper()` and `sys.get_coroutine_wrapper()` were deprecated in Python 3.7 and removed in Python 3.8.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindTelnetlibModule
description: The `telnetlib` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Consider using `telnetlib3` from PyPI, direct socket usage, or SSH-based alternatives like paramiko.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindTempfileMktemp
description: Find usage of `tempfile.mktemp()` which is deprecated due to security concerns (race condition). Use `mkstemp()` or `NamedTemporaryFile()` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindUrllibParseSplitFunctions
description: Find usage of deprecated urllib.parse split functions (splithost, splitport, etc.) removed in Python 3.14. Use urlparse() instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindUrllibParseToBytes
description: Find usage of `urllib.parse.to_bytes()` which was deprecated in Python 3.8 and removed in 3.14. Use str.encode() directly.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindUuModule
description: The `uu` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `base64` module instead for encoding binary data.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.FindXdrlibModule
description: The `xdrlib` module was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Use `struct` module for binary packing/unpacking.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.MigrateAsyncioCoroutine
description: Migrate functions using the deprecated `@asyncio.coroutine` decorator to use `async def` syntax. Also transforms `yield from` to `await`. The decorator was removed in Python 3.11.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.MigrateAvroPython3ToAvro
description: Replace the deprecated `avro-python3` distribution with its maintained successor, Apache `avro`. Both install the same top-level `avro` import package, so module imports are unchanged, but `avro-python3`'s `avro.schema.Parse` was renamed to the lowercase `avro.schema.parse` (and `Parse` removed) in `avro` 1.11+, so that reference is rewritten. The dependency swap is applied by `org.openrewrite.python.ChangeDependency`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.RemoveFutureImports
description: Remove `from __future__ import ...` statements for features that are enabled by default in Python 3.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceArrayFromstring
description: Replace `fromstring()` with `frombytes()` on array objects. The fromstring() method was deprecated in Python 3.2 and removed in 3.14.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceArrayTostring
description: Replace `tostring()` with `tobytes()` on array objects. The tostring() method was deprecated in Python 3.2 and removed in 3.14.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstBytes
description: The `ast.Bytes` node type was deprecated in Python 3.8 and removed in Python 3.14. Replace with `ast.Constant` and check `isinstance(node.value, bytes)`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstEllipsis
description: The `ast.Ellipsis` node type was deprecated in Python 3.8 and removed in Python 3.14. Replace with `ast.Constant` and check `node.value is ...`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstNameConstant
description: The `ast.NameConstant` node type was deprecated in Python 3.8 and removed in Python 3.14. Replace with `ast.Constant` and check `node.value in (True, False, None)`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstNum
description: The `ast.Num` node type was deprecated in Python 3.8 and removed in Python 3.14. Replace with `ast.Constant` and check `isinstance(node.value, (int, float, complex))`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceAstStr
description: The `ast.Str` node type was deprecated in Python 3.8 and removed in Python 3.14. Replace with `ast.Constant` and check `isinstance(node.value, str)`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceCalendarConstants
displayName: Replace deprecated calendar constants with uppercase
description: Replace deprecated mixed-case calendar constants like `calendar.January` with their uppercase equivalents like `calendar.JANUARY`. The mixed-case constants were deprecated in Python 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceCgiParseQs
description: `cgi.parse_qs()` was removed in Python 3.8. Use `urllib.parse.parse_qs()` instead. Note: this rewrites call sites but does not manage imports. Use with `ChangeImport` in a composite recipe to update `from` imports.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceCgiParseQsl
description: `cgi.parse_qsl()` was removed in Python 3.8. Use `urllib.parse.parse_qsl()` instead. Note: this rewrites call sites but does not manage imports. Use with `ChangeImport` in a composite recipe to update `from` imports.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceCollectionsAbcImports
description: Migrate deprecated abstract base class imports from `collections` to `collections.abc`. These imports were deprecated in Python 3.3 and removed in Python 3.10.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceConditionNotifyAll
description: Replace `notifyAll()` method calls with `notify_all()`. The camelCase version was deprecated in Python 3.10 and removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceConfigparserReadfp
description: The `ConfigParser.readfp()` method was deprecated in Python 3.2 and removed in Python 3.13. Replace with `read_file()`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceConfigparserSafeConfigParser
description: The `configparser.SafeConfigParser` class was deprecated in Python 3.2 and removed in Python 3.12. Replace with `configparser.ConfigParser`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceDatetimeUtcFromTimestamp
description: The `datetime.utcfromtimestamp()` method is deprecated in Python 3.12. Replace it with `datetime.fromtimestamp(ts, datetime.UTC)` for timezone-aware datetime objects.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceDatetimeUtcNow
description: The `datetime.utcnow()` method is deprecated in Python 3.12. Replace it with `datetime.now(datetime.UTC)` for timezone-aware datetime objects.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceDistutilsVersion
description: Detect usage of deprecated `distutils.version.LooseVersion` and `distutils.version.StrictVersion`. These should be migrated to `packaging.version.Version`. Note: Manual migration is required as `packaging.version.Version` is not a drop-in replacement.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceElementGetchildren
description: Replace `getchildren()` with `list(element)` on XML Element objects. Deprecated in Python 3.9.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceElementGetiterator
description: Replace `getiterator()` with `iter()` on XML Element objects. The getiterator() method was deprecated in Python 3.9.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceEventIsSet
description: Replace `isSet()` method calls with `is_set()`. The camelCase version was deprecated in Python 3.10 and removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceGettextDeprecations
description: Replace deprecated gettext functions like `lgettext()` with their modern equivalents like `gettext()`. The l*gettext() functions were removed in Python 3.11.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceHtmlParserUnescape
description: `HTMLParser.unescape()` was removed in Python 3.9. Use `html.unescape()` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceLocaleResetlocale
description: The `locale.resetlocale()` function was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in Python 3.13. Replace with `locale.setlocale(locale.LC_ALL, '')`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplacePercentFormatWithFString
description: Replace `"..." % (...)` expressions with f-strings (Python 3.6+). Only converts `%s` and `%r` specifiers where the format string is a literal and the conversion is safe.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplacePkgutilFindLoader
description: The `pkgutil.find_loader()` function was deprecated in Python 3.12. Replace with `importlib.util.find_spec()`. Note: returns ModuleSpec, use .loader for loader.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplacePkgutilGetLoader
description: The `pkgutil.get_loader()` function was deprecated in Python 3.12. Replace with `importlib.util.find_spec()`. Note: returns ModuleSpec, use .loader for loader.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplacePlatformPopen
description: `platform.popen()` was removed in Python 3.8. Use `subprocess.check_output(cmd, shell=True)` instead. Note: this rewrites call sites but does not manage imports.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceReTemplate
description: `re.template()` was deprecated in Python 3.11 and removed in 3.13. Calls are auto-replaced with `re.compile()`. `re.TEMPLATE`/`re.T` flags have no direct replacement and are flagged for manual review.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceStrFormatWithFString
description: Replace `"...".format(...)` calls with f-strings (Python 3.6+). Only converts cases where the format string is a literal and the conversion is safe.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceSysLastExcInfo
description: `sys.last_type`, `sys.last_value`, and `sys.last_traceback` were deprecated in Python 3.12. Replace them with their `sys.last_exc`-based equivalents: `type(sys.last_exc)`, `sys.last_exc`, and `sys.last_exc.__traceback__` respectively.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTarfileFilemode
description: `tarfile.filemode` was removed in Python 3.8. Use `stat.filemode()` instead.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadGetName
description: Replace `getName()` method calls with the `name` property. Deprecated in Python 3.10, removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadIsAlive
description: Replace `isAlive()` method calls with `is_alive()`. Deprecated in Python 3.1 and removed in 3.9.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadIsDaemon
description: Replace `isDaemon()` method calls with the `daemon` property. Deprecated in Python 3.10, removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadSetDaemon
description: Replace `setDaemon()` method calls with `daemon` property assignment. Deprecated in Python 3.10, removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadSetName
description: Replace `setName()` method calls with `name` property assignment. Deprecated in Python 3.10, removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadingActiveCount
description: Replace `threading.activeCount()` with `threading.active_count()`. The camelCase version was deprecated in Python 3.10 and removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceThreadingCurrentThread
description: Replace `threading.currentThread()` with `threading.current_thread()`. The camelCase version was deprecated in Python 3.10 and removed in 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingCallableWithCollectionsAbcCallable
description: PEP 585 deprecated `typing.Callable` in Python 3.9. Replace with `collections.abc.Callable` for type annotations.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingDictWithDict
description: PEP 585 deprecated `typing.Dict` in Python 3.9. Replace with the built-in `dict` type for generic annotations.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingListWithList
description: PEP 585 deprecated `typing.List` in Python 3.9. Replace with the built-in `list` type for generic annotations.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingOptionalWithUnion
description: PEP 604 introduced the `|` operator for union types in Python 3.10. Replace `Optional[X]` with the more concise `X | None` syntax.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingSetWithSet
description: PEP 585 deprecated `typing.Set` in Python 3.9. Replace with the built-in `set` type for generic annotations.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingText
description: `typing.Text` is deprecated as of Python 3.11. It was an alias for `str` for Python 2/3 compatibility. Replace with `str`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingTupleWithTuple
description: PEP 585 deprecated `typing.Tuple` in Python 3.9. Replace with the built-in `tuple` type for generic annotations.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceTypingUnionWithPipe
description: PEP 604 introduced the `|` operator for union types in Python 3.10. Replace `Union[X, Y, ...]` with the more concise `X | Y | ...` syntax.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.ReplaceUnittestDeprecatedAliases
description: Replace deprecated unittest.TestCase method aliases like `assertEquals` with their modern equivalents like `assertEqual`. These aliases were removed in Python 3.11/3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython310
description: Migrate deprecated APIs and adopt new syntax for Python 3.10 compatibility. This includes adopting PEP 604 union type syntax (`X | Y`) and other modernizations between Python 3.9 and 3.10.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython311
description: Migrate deprecated and removed APIs for Python 3.11 compatibility. This includes handling removed modules, deprecated functions, and API changes between Python 3.10 and 3.11.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython312
description: Migrate deprecated and removed APIs for Python 3.12 compatibility. This includes detecting usage of the removed `imp` module and other legacy modules that were removed in Python 3.12.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython313
description: Migrate deprecated and removed APIs for Python 3.13 compatibility. This includes detecting usage of modules removed in PEP 594 ('dead batteries'), other API changes between Python 3.12 and 3.13, and bumping third-party dependencies (`ruff`, `avro-python3`) whose pinned releases do not install cleanly on Python 3.13.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython314
description: Migrate deprecated and removed APIs for Python 3.14 compatibility. This includes replacing deprecated AST node types with `ast.Constant` and other API changes between Python 3.13 and 3.14.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython38
description: Migrate deprecated APIs and detect legacy patterns for Python 3.8 compatibility.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.UpgradeToPython39
description: Migrate deprecated APIs for Python 3.9 compatibility. This includes PEP 585 built-in generics, removed base64 functions, and deprecated XML Element methods.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.FindDeprecatedLangchainAgents
description: Find usage of deprecated LangChain agent patterns including `initialize_agent`, `AgentExecutor`, and `LLMChain`. These were deprecated in LangChain v0.2 and removed in v1.0.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.FindLangchainCreateReactAgent
description: Find `from langgraph.prebuilt import create_react_agent` which should be replaced with `from langchain.agents import create_agent` in LangChain v1.0.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.ReplaceLangchainClassicImports
description: Migrate legacy chain, retriever, and indexing imports from `langchain` to `langchain_classic`. These were moved in LangChain v1.0.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.ReplaceLangchainCommunityImports
description: Migrate third-party integration imports from `langchain` to `langchain_community`. These integrations were moved in LangChain v0.2.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.ReplaceLangchainProviderImports
description: Migrate provider-specific imports from `langchain_community` to dedicated provider packages like `langchain_openai`, `langchain_anthropic`, etc.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.UpgradeToLangChain02
description: Migrate to LangChain 0.2 by updating imports from `langchain` to `langchain_community` and provider-specific packages.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.langchain.UpgradeToLangChain1
description: Migrate to LangChain 1.0 by applying all v0.2 migrations and then moving legacy functionality to `langchain_classic`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.FindDeprecatedJsonEncoders
description: Pydantic deprecated the `json_encoders` option in `ConfigDict`. Its replacements (`@field_serializer` / `@model_serializer` or `Annotated[..., PlainSerializer(...)]`) require restructuring, so this recipe flags its use for review.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.FindDeprecatedSchemaGenerator
description: Pydantic 2.10 deprecated the `schema_generator` option in `ConfigDict`. It has no public replacement yet, so this recipe flags its use for review.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.FindEvalTypeBackportUsage
description: Pydantic 2.14 removed its support for the `eval_type_backport` package. With the Python 3.10 minimum it is no longer needed. This recipe flags `import eval_type_backport` and `from eval_type_backport import ...` for review.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.FindModelValidatorAfterClassmethod
description: Pydantic 2.12 deprecated `@model_validator` with `mode='after'` on a classmethod; the implicit classmethod conversion for `after` model validators is removed in V3. Such validators should be instance methods (`self`, no `@classmethod`). This recipe flags the decorator for review, since the rewrite is not safe to mechanize. `field_validator` is unaffected.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.FindSerializeAsAnyUsage
displayName: Find `serialize_as_any` usage affected by the Pydantic 2.12 unification
description: Pydantic 2.12 unified the `serialize_as_any` flag with the `SerializeAsAny` annotation, which can change serialization output versus 2.11. This recipe flags `serialize_as_any=` on `model_dump` / `model_dump_json` (and `TypeAdapter.dump_python` / `dump_json`) for review, since there is no safe mechanical rewrite.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.RemoveEllipsisFromField
description: Pydantic 2.10 recommends against using `Ellipsis` (`...`) with `Field` to mark a field as required, as it does not play well with static type checkers. Rewrite `Field(...)` to `Field()` (and `Field(..., x=y)` to `Field(x=y)`), keeping the remaining arguments. Only calls resolving to `pydantic.fields.Field` are rewritten.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.ReplaceFinalFieldWithClassVar
displayName: Replace `Final` model fields with a default with `ClassVar`
description: Pydantic 2.11 deprecates annotating a model field as `Final` with a default value (such fields were treated as class variables). Replace `Final[X] = default` with `ClassVar[X] = default`, which preserves the existing class-variable behavior and is the replacement Pydantic recommends.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.ReplaceModelFieldsInstanceAccess
description: Pydantic 2.11 deprecated accessing `model_fields` and `model_computed_fields` on a model instance; these are removed in Pydantic 3.0. Replace `<instance>.model_fields` with `type(<instance>).model_fields` (and likewise for `model_computed_fields`) when the receiver resolves to a Pydantic model, so the attribute is accessed on the class. Class access and `cls` access are left untouched.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.ReplacePopulateByNameWithValidateByName
description: Pydantic 2.11 introduced `validate_by_name` as the equivalent of `populate_by_name`, which is pending deprecation in Pydantic V3. Rename `ConfigDict(populate_by_name=...)` to `ConfigDict(validate_by_name=...)`. This is behavior-preserving (`validate_by_alias` defaults to `True`) and future-proofs the configuration.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.UpgradeToPydantic210
description: Flag and migrate code affected by deprecations introduced in Pydantic 2.10, such as the deprecated `schema_generator` config option and the discouraged `Field(...)` Ellipsis form. Also flags the deprecated `json_encoders` config option.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.UpgradeToPydantic211
description: Migrate code affected by deprecations introduced in Pydantic 2.11 (and 2.10). Rewrites instance access of `model_fields` / `model_computed_fields` to class access, rewrites `Final` model fields with default values to `ClassVar`, and renames `populate_by_name` to `validate_by_name`.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.UpgradeToPydantic212
description: Migrate code affected by changes introduced in Pydantic 2.12 (and 2.10/2.11). Flags `serialize_as_any` usage affected by the 2.12 unification with the `SerializeAsAny` annotation.

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.UpgradeToPydantic213
description: Migrate code for Pydantic 2.13. Pydantic 2.13 introduced no new deprecations (an additive release), so this applies all Pydantic 2.12 migrations (which chain back to 2.10).

name: org.openrewrite.python.migrate.pydantic.UpgradeToPydantic214
description: Migrate code affected by changes introduced in Pydantic 2.14 (and 2.10-2.13). Flags `eval_type_backport` usage, whose support 2.14 removed. Note: 2.14 is in prerelease; verify against the 2.14.0 GA release.
